title: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) – Client Advisory & Accounting Services
description:
Certified Public Accountant (CPA) – Client Advisory & Accounting Services

Full-Time Remote Position

Philippines-Based Applicants Only



About Accuwise

Accuwise is America's Small Business CPA Firm™.

Our mission is to help small business owners know their numbers, stay compliant, and grow profitable businesses through proactive accounting, tax, payroll, and financial advisory services.

We serve small businesses throughout the United States and are building a modern, technology-driven CPA firm focused on exceptional client service, financial clarity, and long-term client relationships.



Position Overview

This is a senior-level accounting position for an experienced CPA who can manage U.S.-based clients and serve as a trusted financial advisor.

This role is not limited to bookkeeping or tax preparation.

The ideal candidate will help clients understand their financial position, maintain accurate accounting records, improve reporting quality, and provide proactive guidance to business owners.

You will work directly with U.S.-based small business clients and collaborate with internal tea
mbers to ensure exceptional service delivery.

CPA designation is required.



Responsibilities

Client Accounting Services

Manage a portfolio of U.S.-based clients and oversee:

•	Monthly bookkeeping review

•	Financial statement preparation

•	Bank reconciliations

•	Credit card reconciliations

•	General ledger review

•	Month-end close process

•	Financial reporting accuracy



Financial Advisory

Help business owners understand:

•	Profitability

•	Cash flow

•	Financial performance

•	Budgeting

•	Forecasting

•	Key business metrics

Provide proactive recommendations to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.



Client Relationship Management

•	Conduct client meetings

•	Review financial reports with clients

•	Answer accounting and financial questions

•	Maintain strong client relationships

•	Ensure client satisfaction and retention



Tax & Compliance Support

Coordinate with tax preparation teams and assist with:

•	Business tax return review

•	Personal tax return review

•	Tax planning opportunities

•	Sales tax compliance

•	Payroll compliance

•	IRS correspondence support



Accounting Quality Control

•	Review work prepared by accounting staff

•	Identify and correct errors

•	Improve accounting processes

•	Ensure consistency and quality standards



Team Leadership

•	Assist with onboarding new clients

•	Support and mentor junior accounting staff

•	Participate in internal training

•	Help improve systems and workflows

•	Support firm growth initiatives



Qualifications

Required

•	Active CPA designation (Philippine CPA or U.S. CPA)

•	Minimum 5 years of accounting experience

•	Minimum 3 years serving U.S.-based clients

•	Strong understanding of U.S. accounting principles

•	Experience reviewing financial statements

•	Experience working directly with business owners

•	Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

•	Ability to work independently in a remote environment

•	Strong organizational and time management skills



Strongly Preferred

•	U.S. CPA License

•	Experience working in a CPA firm environment

•	Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously

•	Experience providing advisory services

•	Experience reviewing business and individual tax returns

•	Experience supervising accounting staff

•	Experience identifying tax planning opportunities for small business owners



Software Experience

Required

•	QuickBooks Online

•	Dext

•	Expensify



Preferred Business Systems

•	GoHighLevel

•	Microsoft 365

•	Google Workspace



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

•	Thinks beyond bookkeeping.

•	Understands both accounting and taxation.

•	Enjoys working directly with business owners.

•	Can explain financial information in simple terms.

•	Understands how accounting impacts business decisions.

•	Takes ownership of client relationships.

•	Maintains high standards of quality and professionalism.

•	Wants to build a long-term career with a growing CPA firm.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Client Service

Financial Reporting

•	Advisory experience

•	Technical proficiency



Performance Bonuses

Available based on:

•	Client satisfaction

Career Growth Opportunities

As Accuwise continues to grow, opportunities may include:

•	Senior CPA

•	Client Advisory Manager

•	Accounting Manager

•	Director of Client Services

•	Fractional CFO Advisor

At Accuwise, we are building more than an accounting firm.

Know Your Numbers™

title: Technical Marketing Assistant & Cooperative Tech Advisor (Part-Time, Yoga & Wellness Brand)

Job Title: Technical Marketing Assistant & Cooperative Tech Advisor (Part-Time, Yoga & Wellness Brand)

About Us:

Aloha! We are the team behind Kauai Yoga on the Beach.

Based on the beautiful shores of Wailua, Kauai.  

Our mission is to bring restorative healing, nervous system regulation, and the peace of the island to people worldwide. Our aesthetic is deeply rooted in the ocean, nature, and the Aloha spirit, with elegant touches of Art Deco.

I AM Anya!

I am the visionary, the content creator, and the designer. I handle the artwork, the teaching, and the big-picture strategy. I am looking for a highly skilled tech expert to take my completed videos, copy, and designs, and build the digital flow behind the scenes.

Your Role:

You will be the technical architect of our marketing ecosystem. 

I already have a dedicated web developer who handles my websites, so you will focus entirely on
 marketing, YouTube optimization, and social media content distribution & conversion.

More importantly, I want you to act as a cooperative tech advisor. 

You will bounce technical ideas, faster workflows, and software solutions off of me. I will review them—if I love the idea, we implement it; if it doesn't fit the vision, we stick to the original plan. You bring the technical options to the table, and I make the final call. You implement. 

Key Responsibilities:


 Platform Mastery: Export contacts from MailChimp and other lists and perfectly merge them into AWeber. Set up automated
 sequences, ensure tags are firing correctly, and generate the embed codes for my web developer.

 YouTube Optimization:

Upload my existing beach yoga videos, update titles/descriptions (copy provided by me), and utilize advanced YouTube SEO strategies to help us rank.

 Social Media Slicing:

Take my long-form videos, intuitively slice them into highly engaging 10-15 second clips for Instagram Reels and TikTok, add provided text overlays, and schedule them.  I will provide the work flow.

 Cooperative Advising:

Continuously look for ways to streamline our backend tech and pitch those ideas to me for approval.

What You Bring to the Table:

 * High-level tech expertise in AWeber, YouTube Studio, and video editing/repurposing tools.

 * A proactive, communicative working style.

 * An appreciation for wellness, yoga, or holistic brands. We operate with a peaceful, grounding energy.

Compensation & Structure (Part-Time Expert):

We are looking for a top-tier professional who wants a stable, long-term supplementary client. This is a strictly part-time role requiring approximately 5 to 10 hours per week  (budgeted at a competitive expert hourly rate, totaling roughly $200–$300/month).

We will begin with a paid, defined trial project to build and consolidate our initial
 marketing and YouTube ecosystem. Upon a successful launch, this will transition into your ongoing, long-term role for content scheduling, technical advising, and maintenance.

How to Apply:

Please reply with a brief introduction, your specific experience with AWeber and YouTube SEO, and tell me about your favorite beach or ocean memory so I know you read this entire post! And please let me know your favorite color.

Looking forward to finding our perfect collab.

Mahalo ???? 

Anya

title: Product Design Engineer & CAD Drafter | Aluminium Extrusions & Injection Moulding
description:
THE ROLE



We're an Australian architectural building products company at an active stage of product development  new components, new systems, and an expanding product range across two brands. We're looking for a skilled product design engineer and CAD drafter to join us long-term, full-time, and take that development through to production-ready documentation.



This is hands-on technical work. You'll take concepts and specifications and turn them into accurate, professional production drawings the kind a manufacturer can work from without a phone call. Aluminium extrusion profiles and injection-moulded components are our primary focus.



THE BUSINESSES



A premium electrically operable louvre pergola system designed and engineered in Australia, supplied to architects, builders, commercial operators and developers.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Producing accurate 3D models in OnShape, Sketchup or SolidWorks from briefs, sketches and specifications

- Drafting production drawings for aluminium extrusion profiles — die drawings, cross-sections, dimensional tolerances

- Drafting production drawings for injection-moulded components part geometry, draft angles, wall thickness, tolerances, material callouts

- Producing shop drawings to a standard that can go directly to a fabricator or manufacturer

- Converting and exporting files between formats (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF and similar) as required

- Maintaining and organising the product drawing library with clean version control

- Supporting the product development process as new components and systems are designed.

- Also need to have experience with Sketchup, this is important. 



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Non-negotiable:

- Demonstrated experience producing manufacturing drawings for aluminium extrusion profiles, or fabricated parts, injection-moulded components and die cast parts. 

- Proven ability to produce clean, complete shop drawings from a written specification or sketch

- Proficiency in OnShape — this is our preferred platform. SolidWorks will be considered for candidates with strong manufacturing drawing experience

- File conversion across common engineering formats (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF)

- Strong attention to detail — drawings go to manufacturers; errors cost money

- Reliable, self-directed and able to manage your own workload



Advantageous:

- Background in architectural, construction or building products environments

- Experience with aluminium systems — pergolas, facades, windows, louvres or similar

- Familiarity with Australian or international drafting standards

- Experience working with Australian clients



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Long-term engagement — this is not a project post

- Our team works 7:00 am – 3:00 pm Perth, Western Australia time (WST / UTC+8)

- We're flexible on timezone for the right candidate please tell us where you are and your preferred working hours in your application



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following — applications without these items will not be reviewed:



1. A brief introduction: your background, the industries you've worked in, and the types of products you've drafted

2. Portfolio examples — screenshots or files showing production drawings you've completed for aluminium extrusion profiles and/or injection-moulded components. Show us drawings that went to a manufacturer, not student or tutorial work

3. Confirmation of your primary CAD platform (OnShape or SolidWorks) and your proficiency level

4. Your location and preferred working hours

5. Your hourly rate in USD

title: Short-form video editor for ongoing Reels & TikToks — long-term, one creator
description:
LOOKING FOR A SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR TO GROW 

WITH — LONG-TERM, ONE PERSON (NOT AN AGENCY)



Hi! I'm Meadhbh 
 — an integrative somatic practitioner. I create content on nervous system regulation, parts work (IFS-informed), somatic healing, and authentic alignment for high-functioning, highly sensitive women who are done performing and ready to come home to themselves.



I'm scaling up and looking for one editor to work with me directly, long-term — someone who learns my visual world, grows with the account, and becomes my go-to person (not a rotating team/an agency).



What you'd be editing:

- Short-form: Reels — primarily talking head, some collage/voiceover and b-roll

- Roughly 5 videos per week



My style:

I care about the details — fonts, colour, pacing, sound design, and the way things move on screen. Specifically, I love:

- Sound effects, key text/copy pop-ups, icons, and subtle zooms that follow hand gestures and emphasis

- Captions that appear one word at a time, with small white space/pauses cut between words where it sounds right

- Relevant inserted clips or references woven in where it adds to the story

- Engaging opens — sometimes a green-screen backdrop, sometimes extra imagery at the start to hook attention

- Tasteful use of emojis and cute icons (like gold stars) for warmth, never overdone



I'm sending over a full visual reference file so you can see exactly the tone, pacing, and energy I'm going for. I'm not after templated or AI auto-edited content — I want a real point of view that fits the soul of this work.



How we'd work together:

- Batch filming, then building content out together

- Briefs, references, and footage organised in Notion (tags, timestamps, mentions)

- Fast, casual feedback over WhatsApp

- Paid day rate of  $250–400 depending on experience and portfolio. We'll agree your rate together after the test edit, based on turnaround speed and skill shown. No "one round of edits" packages. I want this to feel collaborative, not transactional.



You're a great fit if you:

- Have a portfolio with a clear, distinctive visual style (send me 2–3 of your best)

- Are reliable, communicative, fluent in English (reading/writing/listening) and devoted to deadlines

- Take pride in the craft and have opinions on what makes a video land

- Bonus: any familiarity with wellness, somatic, or trauma-informed content — though not essential if your editing instincts are strong



To apply, send:

1. Your portfolio/showreel

2. A line on the kind of content and style you love editing



Next step: I'll shortlist a few people for a short, paid test edit (talking head or b-roll with voiceover) so we can both see if it's a fit.

title: Fraud Auditor
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical KYC Auditor to join our team. This is a full-time remote position focused on reviewing and verifying various types of documents to ensure they are authentic and meet our compliance standards.

As a KYC Auditor, you will examine documents such as identification records, bank statements, utility bills, and other supporting files. Your role is to carefully analyze these documents, identify any inconsistencies or red flags, and provide clear reasoning for your conclusions. Accuracy and thoroughness are extremely important because mistakes or missed issues can create serious compliance risks.

This is a high-trust role that requires strong attention to detail and the ability to think critically when reviewing information. We are not looking for someone who simply checks boxes. We need someone who can carefully examine documents, spot subtle issues, and explain their findings clearly.

Key Responsibilities:



Review and analyze various types of client documents including IDs, bank statements, utility bills, and other supporting records.

Identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, or potential signs of document alteration.

Provide clear and well-reasoned assessments on whether documents appear genuine or suspicious.

Maintain accurate records of reviews and findings.

Follow established processes while also suggesting improvements when better approaches are identified.

Communicate findings effectively when further clarification or escalation is needed.



Requirements:



Strong attention to detail and a careful, analytical mindset.

Good written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain reasoning clearly.

Ability to work independently and manage your own time effectively.

Comfortable reviewing documents and working with digital files on a daily basis.

Previous experience in KYC, compliance, document review, or auditing is a plus but not required.

Must be reliable, consistent, and serious about producing high-quality work.



We are looking to hire someone for the long term who can grow with the role. In the past, we found that our hiring process was not strict enough, which led to bringing on people who were not suited for this type of detailed and careful work. We are now being much more selective.

Our application process includes a document review assessment to better understand how candidates analyze information and spot issues. We strongly discourage the use of AI tools to complete the assessment. Generic or low-effort responses are easy to identify and will result in disqualification.

If you are someone who takes pride in being thorough, enjoys analyzing details, and is looking for a long-term remote role where careful and accurate work actually matters, we encourage you to apply.

Please apply through the link below and complete the full application process, including the assessment. Only serious candidates who are willing to put in genuine effort will be considered.

title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:

https://airtable(dot) com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via email, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our team members as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.



- Real Career Growth: We're expanding quickly, which means new roles and responsibilities open up regularly. We actively develop our people through mentorship, skill-building, and increasing ownership of projects.



- A Team That Feels Like a Team: We're a close, collaborative group that celebrates wins together. You'll know your teammates by name, including leadership.





HiEnd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Hospice Healthcare Recruiter

Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive to White Orchid Hospice



White Orchid Hospice is looking for an experienced, highly motivated Hospice Healthcare Recruiter to lead full-cycle recruiting for all four of our hospice locations.



We are not looking for a passive recruiter who just posts jobs and waits. We want someone who knows how to find talent, create interest, build urgency, and close candidates. This role requires a recruiter who is confident, proactive, organized, and excellent at selling candidates on our company and opportunity.



If you have strong healthcare recruiting experience, direct hospice recruiting experience, and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with Americans, we want to hear from you.



What You’ll Do

You will manage the recruiting process from start to finish across multiple locations. This includes sourcing candidates, reviewing resumes, screening applicants, coordinating interviews, following up consistently, helping move candidates through the hiring process, and supporting successful hires.



You must be able to recruit aggressively, keep pipelines active, and generate quality candidates for hospice-related openings. Just as importantly, you must be able to represent White Orchid Hospice well and effectively communicate why candidates should choose to join our team.



What We Need

You must have at least 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience and at least 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience. This is required.



You must be fluent in English, both written and verbal, and able to communicate smoothly with Americans without the conversation feeling difficult or awkward because you are overseas.



You must be confident on calls, strong in candidate follow-up, and skilled at building trust and excitement with potential hires. We are looking for someone who can sell, not just screen.



This is a fully dedicated role. You must be committed exclusively to White Orchid Hospice and cannot have any other jobs, clients, contracts, or side work.



Ideal Candidate

The right person is aggressive, responsive, persuasive, and dependable. You know how to source, engage, and close healthcare talent. You understand the pace and demands of hospice recruiting. You are comfortable managing multiple openings at once and know how to stay organized, move fast, and communicate clearly.



Requirements

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:



Minimum 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience

Minimum 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience

Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

Ability to communicate comfortably and professionally with Americans

Proven ability to source, engage, and close candidates

Strong full-cycle recruiting experience

Must be fully dedicated to White Orchid Hospice only

No other active jobs, clients, or outside work commitments

Why This Role Matters

This is an important position for our organization. You will directly impact our ability to grow strong teams across all four locations. We need someone who can take ownership of recruiting, work with urgency, and help us hire great people who fit our mission and standards.



How to Apply

When applying, please include a short message answering the following:



How many years of healthcare recruiting experience do you have?

How many years of direct hospice recruiting experience do you have?

What hospice positions have you recruited for?

Are you currently working for any other employer or client?

Can you commit exclusively to White Orchid Hospice?

Why are you a strong fit for this role?

mber (TM) will be responsible for handling the corporate books for three closely related entities and supporting the Finance Team with day-to-day accounting operations, reporting, and financial analysis.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We are hiring a full-time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to call U.S. local service businesses from a pre-built list of prospects.



This role is mostly phone work. About 95% of the job is making outbound cold calls, following a simple script, qualifying the business, taking notes, and trying to book qualified appointments. This is not a general VA role, and it is not mostly lead research, social media, or
 work.



Schedule:

- Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

- 1-hour lunch break at 12:00 PM Eastern Time

- This is a night-shift role for candidates in the Philippines



Compensation and benefits:

- Base pay: PHP 50,000/month

- Paid weekly via PayPal or Wise

- Commission/bonus eligibility after 30 calendar days or after 15 qualified appointments, whichever comes first, as long as call quality and CRM accuracy meet standards

- 13th-month pay

- U.S. and Philippine holidays off

- 5 paid time off days after 1 year

- First 30 days are a paid evaluation/training period

- Long-term role for the right person



We provide:

- Cold lead list

- Call script

- CRM/tracking system

- Dialer/phone system

- Training and feedback



What you will do:

- Call prospects from a preset list provided by our team

- Follow a clear script and qualification process

- Ask simple questions to see if the business is a good fit

- Handle basic objections politely and keep the call moving

- Book qualified appointments when there is interest

- Leave voi
 or mark the result when there is no answer

- Update call status, notes, and next steps in our tracking sheet / CRM after every call

- Make approximately 120 outbound calls per day

- Report daily call activity, booked appointments, blockers, and notes



You should apply if:

- You have real cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, SDR, or outbound sales experience

- You are comfortable making many calls every workday

- You speak clear English and can sound confident, friendly, and professional on the phone

- You can handle rejection without getting discouraged

- You are reliable, organized, and able to follow a repeatable process

- You can take feedback and improve your calls over time

- You have a quiet workspace, good headset, stable internet, and backup internet preferred



This is probably NOT a fit if:

- You do not want to make phone calls most of the day

- You only want admin, data entry, chat support, social media, or
 work

- You are uncomfortable speaking with business owners or decision makers

- You cannot reliably work U.S. Eastern business hours long-term



Helpful experience:

- Cold calling for agencies, real estate, SaaS, home services, marketing, insurance, or other B2B services

- Appointment setting or telemarketing

- CRM tools, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar

- Dialers, VoIP tools, call tracking, call disposition notes, and follow-up workflows



To apply, please answer these questions:

1. What cold calling or appointment setting experience do you have?

2. How many outbound calls have you typically made per day in past roles?

3. Are you comfortable with this role being about 95% cold calling from a preset list?

4. Confirm you can work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time with lunch at 12:00 PM Eastern.

5. Confirm you understand base pay is PHP 50,000/month, paid weekly via PayPal or Wise, with commission/bonus eligibility after the training/quality threshold.

6. Give one example of appointments booked, leads qualified, sales calls made, quota, KPI, or other measurable result.

7. What tools have you used for calling, CRM, or tracking outreach?

8. What is your internet speed and backup internet/power situation?

9. Please include a short voice recording or video introduction if you have one.



We are looking for someone long-term who can become a dependable cold calling and appointment setting operator as the process scales.

title: Cold Calling Team Lead – Real Estate Acquisitions
description:
We are a fast growing, data driven real estate investment firm specializing in creative financing strategies. We are seeking an experienced Cold Calling Team Lead to spearhead our outbound prospecting department.



In this role, you will lead by example—personally executing outbound calls to qualify motivated sellers—while managing, training, and optimizing a small team of cold callers. You will serve as the engine of our acquisitions pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of prequalified appointments for our Closing team.



Core Responsibilities:



1. High Volume Prospecting: Execute outbound campaigns to skip traced property lists and inbound CRM leads. Qualify property owners using the “4 Pillars of Real Estate Direct Acquisitions”: Condition, Timeline, Motivation, and Price. Schedule and hand off appointments to Acquisitions Closers.



2. Team Leadership: Provide daily oversight, motivation, and guidance to cold callers. Conduct QA audits and call listening sessions. Onboard and train new callers on real estate frameworks and objection handling.



3. Data Management: Maintain CRM and dialing system accuracy. Track and report KPIs (call volume, contact rates, leads, appointments) to leadership.



Required Qualifications:



- Proven experience in US real estate cold calling (wholesaling, creative finance, or turnkey investing preferred).

- Demonstrated leadership in training/managing virtual assistants or phone prospectors.

- Strong English communication skills with neutral accent.

- Handson experience with GoHighLevel, BatchDialer, and PropStream.

- Reliable internet (wired preferred), power backup, and quiet home office.



Compensation & Benefits:



- Base Salary: $700–$900 USD/month (depending on experience).

- Uncapped performance incentives: bonuses for qualified appointments + commissions on closed deals.

- Growth potential: path to expanded management or closing roles.



Schedule & Environment: 



- Fulltime (40 hrs/week), US business hours (Pacific Standard Time).

- 100% Remote / Homebased.



How to Apply:



Please submit the following:

- Resume/CV highlighting US real estate experience

- 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself, your cold calling background, and why you’re the ideal fit to lead our team



You may send these directly through the OnlineJobs.ph message inbox.

Contact Person: Racquel Joy Guiyab

title: Maintenance Coordinator (Bilingual English/Spanish)
description:

This role will utilize AppFolio and Maintenance Performer, an AI-powered maintenance management platform, to streamline maintenance operations, monitor work order progress, and ensure timely resolution of tenant requests.

This individual will serve as a key liaison between English- and Spanish-speaking tenants, vendors, and the internal property management team to ensure a high level of service and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage and track maintenance requests through AppFolio and Maintenance Performer from initiation to completion.

Leverage Maintenance Performer's AI-powered workflows and tools to improve maintenance coordination, communication, and work order resolution times.

Review incoming maintenance requests and assess urgency to ensure time-sensitive issues are prioritized appropriately.

Coordinate with tenants, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to schedule and facilitate maintenance work.

Monitor the progress of open work orders and follow up to ensure timely completion.

Communicate with tenants regarding maintenance status, scheduling, and resolution updates.

Coordinate with vendors to obtain updates, schedule repairs, and ensure service expectations are met.

Escalate urgent maintenance concerns and provide timely updates to the property management team.

Assist with lease administration, including preparing and sending lease documents.

Follow up with tenants regarding past-due rent balances and payment arrangements.

Support the eviction process by preparing and managing eviction intake documentation.

Assist with additional property management and administrative tasks as needed.





Required Skills & Qualifications:

Previous property management, assistant property management, or property administration experience preferred.

Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate professionally with Spanish-speaking tenants, vendors, and property owners.

Experience with AppFolio is highly preferred, with the ability to navigate and manage property management workflows efficiently.

Experience with Maintenance Performer or other AI-powered property management and maintenance platforms is a plus.

Experience coordinating maintenance requests, work orders, vendors, and tenant communications.

Strong understanding of maintenance workflows and the ability to assess and prioritize requests based on urgency.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving skills and follow-through.

Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a distributed team.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and property management systems.

Ability to maintain professionalism when communicating with tenants, vendors, and internal tea
mbers.

Experience with lease administration, rent collection follow-up, or eviction processes is a plus.

Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you’re interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.



Why strong setters join us



We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there’s no ceiling on what you can earn each month.



02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You’ll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what’s working, coach on what isn’t, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You’ll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — every one, on top of the base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works:



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an extra ~$375/month. At Gold level, that’s an extra ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we’ll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.



Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.



Who we’re looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.



A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.



Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.



Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.



Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.



What you’re walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously.



You’ll know exactly what’s expected, exactly what you’ll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.



Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out

title: Dating App Assistant
description:
Personal Dating App Manager (Ghostwriter–Operator)





I'm hiring someone to run the day-to-day of my dating profiles. You're the engine behind the scenes: curating matches, opening conversations, keeping promising ones warm, and getting the good ones to a scheduled date. I handle the actual dates — you handle everything up to them.



This is fast AI-assisted drafting with light judgment, not pure copy-paste. You'll use tools to generate options quickly, but you read the thread and pick or adjust so it lands like a real person. The difference between a date and a dead conversation is usually one good reply at the unexpected 
nt — that's the skill I'm hiring for.



Apps you'd manage: [Hinge / Bumble / Tinder / etc.]

Goal: [be specific — e.g. "consistent, quality first dates with people I'd actually click with"]





What you'll do





Review and curate matches against a preferences brief I'll give you

Write openers and carry conversations in my voice

Keep 
ntum: timely replies, good questions, knowing when to ask someone out

Handle the "message three" save — when someone says something the script didn't anticipate, you keep it alive

Flag standout matches to me before any date is set

Maintain a clean log of who's who so threads never cross

Suggest tweaks to my photos and bio over time based on what's landing

Edit and prep my profile photos — light retouching, cropping, ordering, and basic cleanup so the profile always looks its best (no heavy/deceptive editing; the photos still have to look like me)







Tools & Workflow



You'll operate a defined stack so the work is fast and consistent. I'll provide access and a voice brief.





Drafting — YourMove AI (default engine for openers and replies). [Swap/secondary: SmoothRizz if we prioritize voice-consistency.]

Match tracking — Wingman (AI Dating Coach app): a profile per person so we track what's been said and what's worked, and never cross threads. Also our photo/bio optimizer.

Delivery — the actual apps, by hand. You log in and type inside [Hinge/Bumble/Tinder]. No automation or auto-senders — those get accounts banned. [Optional: Keys AI keyboard to speed up in-app typing, on the dedicated device only.]

Access — 1Password (or Bitwarden): you get login access without raw credentials; I can revoke instantly.

Brief & coordination — shared Notion doc: my voice, preferences, and standing rules live here.

Photo editing — [Lightroom Mobile / Snapseed / Canva / TouchRetouch]: for cropping, light retouching, ordering, and cleanup. Use whichever you're fluent in; just keep edits natural.





The rhythm: read the thread ? generate options ? pick the one that fits and tweak it to sound like me ? send ? log anything worth remembering. Seconds of judgment per message, not minutes of writing.





Who I'm looking for





A genuinely strong, natural writer with range — funny, warm, or sharp depending on the person

High emotional intelligence and a good read on subtext

Comfortable using AI tools to draft fast and the judgment to know when a suggestion is off

Competent with basic photo editing — cropping, light retouching, and selecting the strongest shots

Discreet and trustworthy — this is my actual dating life

Responsive during [active hours]

Bonus: you've done this kind of work before, or you're just unusually good at texting







Confidentiality



You'll have access to my accounts and personal conversations. A basic confidentiality agreement is part of the role — non-negotiable, and I'll provide it before any account access.





How to apply — the screening



I'm using a few short steps instead of a résumé, because the work is the audition.



Step 1 — Quick intro + read-the-brief check (5 min).

A short note answering: why does this kind of work appeal to you? Then, so I know you actually read instructions before acting:





Start your message with the word "Banana."

Keep the whole note under 100 words.

End with one line confirming you're comfortable signing a confidentiality agreement.





No cover letter — keep it human. (If you skip any of the three, I'll assume the instruction-following part of the job isn't a fit, and won't move forward. This is the filter, not a formality.)



Step 2 — Work sample (writing + photo).

I'll send a mock match profile and one sample photo. You'll:





Write the opener you'd send them.

Rewrite this bland bio to make it pull: "[insert a boring sample bio]"

Do a quick, natural edit of the sample photo (crop + light cleanup) and send it back — show me you can make a shot look its best without making it look fake.





Step 3 — The message-three save (the real filter).

I'll give you a conversation that's gone cold, or a match who said something slightly off or unexpected. Show me how you'd recover or respond. This tells me more than anything else.



Step 4 — Paid trial.

Top candidates do a [1–2 week] paid trial on a live account, with me reviewing before anything sends. If it clicks, we make it ongoing.



To start: reply with Step 1 and I'll send the Step 2 brief.





Notes for me before posting: lock the rate and hours (vague pay attracts vague applicants — even a range sharpens the pool a lot), confirm which apps I'm listing, and run YourMove + Wingman through their free trials on my real threads first so I know the stack actually works before handing it off.

If you've hit consistent daily activity targets, kept a clean CRM, and love the feeling of getting a prospect to say "yes, book me in" - keep reading. If you're looking to coast, this isn't your role.

An AI-powered lead generation system built for Home Services businesses (painters, remodelers, and similar trades). The system generates leads, qualifies them with AI voice + text agents, and books appointments directly on our clients' calendars. It works. We took one painter from $295K/year to $1.5M in 14 months. We have killer case studies, a product that delivers, and a closer who converts.

This is consistent, focused work. You'll be working warm inbound leads AND running outbound to home services business owners. Your one job: get qualified decision-makers on the calendar. A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.

- Work inbound leads fast - speed to lead is everything.

title: Demand Generation Specialist
description:
The Demand Generation Specialist will be responsible for creating, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns that generate high-quality, sales-ready leads (MQLs) and accelerate pipeline growth. This role requires a strong blend of analytical skill, creative campaign execution, and technical marketing expertise within a complex B2G/B2I sales environment. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on experience in an agency environment, primarily managing the technical execution of demand generation campaigns in a B2B environment, with a demonstrable track record of improving MQL velocity and quality. This is a Full-Time Remote based role.



Responsibilities & Duties

Campaign Deployment: They are responsible for the hands-on building and launching of all lead generation campaigns.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): They own the testing and optimization of all conversion points—landing pages, forms, and calls-to-action (CTAs). By improving conversion rates by even a few percentage points, they can instantly boost lead volume without increasing ad spend, directly accelerating lead generation efficiency.

Budget Efficiency: They manage the day-to-day bidding and targeting in advertising platforms, ensuring the budget is spent on high-performing segments and channels, which lowers the Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and makes growth more sustainable.

MarTech Management: They manage the technical connections between advertising platforms such as LinkedIn, Google and our source of truth (HubSpot). This ensures reliable data flow, preventing "leaks" in the funnel where valuable leads might be lost.

Lead Nurturing Mechanics: They build, test, and segment the automated
 nurture tracks, ensuring MQLs who aren't yet sales-ready remain engaged with relevant, value-driven content until they show enough intent for a sales handoff.

Lead Follow up: Proactively follow up with new prospects after a webinar and after new prospects have connected with the S2C team at an event.

Reporting: Ensure accurate reporting of new leads and conversations generated.

Audience Segmentation: They execute precise audience targeting based on defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)(e.g., industry, revenue, size, specific titles, existing technology).

Other duties as assigned.



What Success Looks Like

Pipeline generation meets/exceeds goals, becomes more consistent, measurable, and repeatable

The expectation will be to generate 50 net new leads per week, or 200 net news leads per month (you d
 on channel mix)

Marketing and Sales operate with clearer handoffs and strong alignment

HubSpot reporting becomes more trusted and actionable

Messaging and campaigns become sharper, more strategic, and more effective

Leadership gains better visibility into what marketing is contributing and where to invest next

title: Marketing & Sales Support Specialist
description:

Sales Support

s, organizing CRM tasks, and helping the sales team keep follow-up moving.

title: After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround)
description:
After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround)



The role



We are a video editing company working with a roster of YouTube creators and brands, and we are looking for an After Effects specialist who lives and breathes kinetic typography and retention-style motion graphics. If you can make text snap, fly, bounce, and hit on the beat, and you can do it fast without losing quality, keep reading.



You will work across multiple clients and a range of project types, so range matters. That said, one of our primary clients does high-energy retention-style content, and that work will be the bulk of your day to day. The benchmark below shows exactly what that looks like.



This is the bar (watch before applying)



Watch the first 1 minute and 43 seconds of this video. This is the style of our primary client and the bulk of the work you will be doing. This is the level of editing and motion graphics you need to be able to hit:



**
**



Pay attention to how the text animates onto the screen word by word in sync with the speaker, how key words get scaled up, highlighted, underlined, or boxed for emphasis, how the camera punches in and zooms on important 
nts, and how every animation hit is matched with a sound effect. That rhythm and polish is the standard. If you cannot produce work at this level, this role is not the right fit.



What you will be doing



- Editing YouTube videos with heavy motion graphics and animated text

- Building snappy kinetic typography (text floating in, scaling, sliding, word-by-word emphasis)

- Quick zoom-ins, punch-ins, and energetic transitions cut to the audio

- Animated text treatments: underlines, highlights, callouts, lower thirds, on-screen labels

- Mixing typography styles and treatments to match the energy of each 
nt

- Layering sound effects and syncing animation hits to the beat



Must-haves



- **Expert-level After Effects.** This is non-negotiable. You should be able to animate text and graphics fluidly without hunting through tutorials.

- **Strong kinetic typography portfolio.** Show us animated text you personally built, not work you assembled from templates.

- **Fast, reliable turnaround.** You ship polished work on tight deadlines and you hit your dates.

- **A sharp eye for timing, pacing, and sound design.** You know why a cut lands and where a sound effect belongs.

- **Range and adaptability.** You can match different client styles and brand guidelines, not just one look. Reference videos and brand kits should be something you follow closely, not override.

- **Premiere Pro familiarity** for the base edit and assembly.

- **Clear written English and good communication.** You ask smart questions and you do not go quiet mid-project.



Nice to have



- Thumbnail design or Photoshop skills

- Experience working with an agency or juggling multiple clients at once

- Experience in a specific niche (tell us what kind of content you have edited)

- Familiarity with fast-paced, retention-style creator editing (think the energy of Hormozi, MrBeast, or Gadzhi style channels)



How we work



For each project we give you the raw footage, a clear direction, reference videos, and the client's brand guidelines. You bring the energy and the polish, and you match the look the client expects. You will move between clients and project types, so being organized and able to switch gears matters. We value speed, consistency, and someone who makes the work better without needing to be micromanaged.



Because we are an editing company with an active client roster, this is steady, ongoing volume, not one-off gigs. Volume is typically at least 2 videos per week and often more. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to become one of our go-to editors as we grow.





## Hours and availability



This role runs on US business hours. We need you online and reachable during the Central Time workday, roughly 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM CST (US Central Time). You do not have to cover the whole window, but you should be able to commit to a consistent block inside it so we can send feedback, answer questions, and turn revisions around same day.



Please note: these hours are an overnight shift in the Philippines (roughly 8 or 9 PM to 7 or 8 AM your time, depending on the season). Only apply if you are comfortable working nights consistently and on time.



Pay



$15 to $25 per hour depending on speed and skill, with room to grow for the right person. We pay well and on time for great work.



How to apply (read carefully, this is how we filter)



1. Start your message with the word **SNAP** so we know you read the whole post.

2. Send your reel or portfolio. Include 2 or 3 timestamps pointing to kinetic typography or animated text you personally created, and tell us exactly what you did on each.

3. In one or two sentences, tell us the fastest you have ever turned around a fully edited, motion-heavy YouTube video and how long that video was.

4. Tell us honestly: can you produce work at the level of the benchmark video above? If you have something in your reel that comes close to that style, point us to it.

5. List the software you use, the hours you can be online in CST (US Central Time), and your weekly availability.



Generic messages with no reel will not be considered. We are hiring one great person, and the right fit will have steady, long-term work with us.

This is not a general administrative role. This is a communication filter and notification role. Your job is to make sure nothing important gets missed and that the right person knows about it immediately so they can act.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS

You will be the eyes and ears of the executive team across their inboxes and notifications. You will not respond to
s on their behalf. Your job is to monitor, filter, and alert.

When something important comes in, you act immediately. You do not wait. You do not let it sit. You contact the right executive — by text or call — and make sure they know what just landed and what needs to happen next.

 inboxes for Juan, Andrew, and Joseph on a regular basis throughout the business day

s by urgency and importance — separating what needs immediate attention from what can wait

 arrives

 clearly and concisely so the executive can d

s on behalf of the executives

title: Xactimate Repair Estimator / Insurance Reconstruction Estimator — Full-Time
description:
OVERVIEW: Evolution Restoration & Renovation is a US-based restoration and reconstruction company specializing in insurance-driven repair and rebuild projects. We work directly with carriers, TPAs, and adjusters to deliver accurate, approval-ready repair estimates.

We are looking for an experienced Repair Estimator who knows how to build complete, defensible reconstruction scopes from start to finish — drywall, flooring, cabinetry, roofing, painting, structural repairs, and everything in between. This role is repair and reconstruction only. We are not looking for a mitigation estimator.

If you have built real repair scopes in Xactimate, negotiated with adjusters, and written supplements that got approved — this role is for you. If you haven't, this role is not the right fit.

Website: 

LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

SCHEDULE: Full-Time / US Arizona Business Hours

TYPE: Long-Term with Growth Opportunity



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a repair and reconstruction estimating role. We will ask you to walk us through estimates you have written. We will know immediately if your experience is in mitigation instead of repair. Please only apply if you have genuine hands-on experience writing residential repair and reconstruction scopes in Xactimate.



HOW WE WORK

You will receive assignments that include:

Photos of the damage

Matterport scans (used for sketching and measurements in Xactimate)

A short report summarizing the scope of repairs needed

From this information, you will build a complete repair estimate in Xactimate and support the approval and supplement process independently.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Write complete residential repair and reconstruction estimates in Xactimate

Build accurate room sketches using Matterport scans and photo documentation

Scope all repair line items including drywall, flooring, cabinetry, paint, roofing, framing, trim, and related trades

Communicate with TPAs and adjusters to reach approved scopes of work

Prepare and submit supplements with clear justification and supporting documentation

Write structured F9 notes to justify scope and pricing decisions

Revise estimates based on adjuster feedback and carrier guidelines

Maintain organized and well-documented claim files

Create subcontractor scopes of work based on approved estimates

Support project managers by reviewing estimates and explaining line items



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Xactimate experience writing repair and reconstruction estimates — required

Demonstrated ability to scope residential repairs across multiple trades (drywall, flooring, cabinetry, roofing, paint, structural)

Experience working directly with insurance carriers, TPAs, and adjusters

Experience handling supplements, revisions, and scope negotiations

Ability to build complete estimates independently from photos and Matterport scans

Strong written English

Strong F9 note writing and scope justification skills

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple files at once

Ability to work independently without supervision

Looking for a long-term opportunity

This role is not for:

Mitigation-only estimators

Candidates who have only written water extraction or drying scopes

Entry-level candidates who need to be trained on Xactimate from scratch



COMPENSATION

2–3 years experience: $600 – $900/month

3–5 years experience: $900 – $1,200/month

5+ years (advanced): $1,200 – $1,600/month

Compensation depends on demonstrated experience and skill level verified during the interview process.



WHY JOIN US

Stable, long-term US client

Direct exposure to real insurance repair and reconstruction workflows

Work on real files with real approvals — not practice scopes

Opportunity to grow with a company that values estimating quality



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

How many repair and reconstruction estimates have you written in Xactimate? Give us your honest number — and be specific about whether those were repair scopes, mitigation scopes, or both.





Please share 3 repair estimates you have written. Redact client information if needed. We want to see your line items, sketches, F9 notes, and scope structure — not a summary.





Walk us through a supplement you wrote that was initially denied and then approved. What was the situation, what did you write, and what was the outcome?

description:
We run a U.S.-based buyback business. We purchase electronics and diabetic supplies (test strips, CGMs, etc.) from customers who respond to our ads. Our leads come in hot and ready your job is to turn those inbound messages into completed deals: qualify what they have, quote a price, lock in a meeting or shipment, and coordinate the handoff to our buyers.



This is not a cold-calling role. Every person you talk to has already raised their hand. We need someone sharp, organized, and reliable to be the front line and the glue that holds operations together.



What You'll Do



- Respond to all inbound messages (SMS,
/Instagram,
) quickly and professionally — speed matters in this business

- Qualify the customer: find out exactly what they have (model, condition, quantity, expiration dates for supplies)

- Provide accurate quotes using our pricing guides and process

- Set appointments and schedule meet-ups or pickups with our local buyers

- Coordinate with our buyer network — route deals to the right person, confirm details, follow up

- Manage shipping/inventory logistics — send shipping info, track incoming inventory, keep records updated

- Keep our CRM clean and current — log every conversation, status, and next step

- Follow up with leads who go quiet to recover deals that would otherwise be lost



You're a Great Fit If You Have



- Excellent written English,  clear, friendly, professional, no awkward phrasing

- 2+ years in a virtual assistant, customer service, sales coordination, or executive assistant role

- Strong organization, you never let a lead or a task slip through the cracks

- CRM / pipeline experience (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar — bonus, not required)

- Comfort with messaging platforms (SMS tools,
 Messenger,
)

- A proactive, ownership mindset — you solve problems instead of waiting to be told

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup connection



Bonus Points



- Experience in sales, appointment setting, or any buyback/reselling business

- Familiarity with U.S. customers and U.S. time zones

- Basic comfort with spreadsheets and simple data entry



Details



- Type: Full-time, long-term (this is a permanent role, not a short gig)

- Hours: 40 Hours A Week (10-6 CST) 

- Pay:  $3-5.50 an hour depending on experience with room to grow + performance bonuses for closed deals

- Start: As soon as we find the right person



How to Apply



Read this carefully it's our first test of whether you follow instructions:



1. Start your application with the word "BUYBACK" at the very top (applications without it are deleted).

3. Include your typing speed, your internet speed (run a speedtest), and what hours you can work in CST.

As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

security enhancements.

verticals.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience with ITIL frameworks or MSP-specific vCIO tools.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our tea
mbers can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?

mbers.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

tera RMM Specialist / MSP Monitoring Engineer (Proactive IT Operations)

We are a growing Managed IT Services company based in the U.S., and we are looking for a highly skilled Atera RMM Specialist to manage and optimize our monitoring environment.



This is a part-time role (20–30 hours/week) with potential to grow into a long-term position.



This is not a basic helpdesk role. We are specifically looking for someone who has deep hands-on experience with Atera and understands how to use it to proactively manage client environments.



What This Role Is About



You will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and improving our Atera RMM platform across multiple clients.



This includes configuring alerts, managing patching policies, improving automation, and ensuring best practices are followed across all endpoints.



You should be comfortable identifying inefficiencies, reducing alert noise, and proactively improving how the system operates.



Key Responsibilities



Atera RMM Management (Primary Responsibility)



Configure and optimize Atera monitoring policies

Manage and improve alert thresholds and system health monitoring

Monitor and maintain patch management policies across endpoints

Identify and reduce false positives and alert noise

Create, modify, or run scripts for automation and deployments

Ensure all endpoints are properly monitored and compliant

Assist with onboarding new client environments into Atera



Proactive Monitoring



Perform daily and weekly system checks

Identify issues before users report them

Maintain visibility across all managed devices



Ticket and Support (Secondary Responsibility)



Assist with ticket management as needed

Document actions and maintain clear notes

Support basic troubleshooting when required



Documentation and Process



Maintain internal documentation and notes

Help improve SOPs and monitoring workflows

Provide recommendations to improve system performance and efficiency



Requirements (Important)



Must-Have:



Strong hands-on experience with Atera (not just basic usage)

Previous experience working in an MSP environment

Experience managing multiple client environments

Strong understanding of:

Windows systems

Microsoft 365

Basic networking

Experience with RMM tools, monitoring systems, and automation

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail



Nice to Have:



Experience with scripting or automation

Experience with Active Directory and Azure / Entra ID

Experience with VoIP or networking systems



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who:



Has deep Atera experience and understands how to optimize it

Is proactive and thinks in terms of systems and processes

Can identify problems before they become issues

Takes ownership of their work

Is reliable and detail-oriented



Schedule



Part-time: 20–30 hours per week

Must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time



Compensation



Based on experience

Higher compensation available for candidates with strong Atera expertise

Opportunity for long-term growth



How to Apply



To apply, please include:



Your experience specifically with Atera (detailed)

Your experience working in an MSP environment

A real example of how you used Atera (or another RMM) to improve monitoring, patching, or automation

The word “PROACTIVE” at the top of your application
