description:
TRUST ELITE CLEANING SOLUTIONS

VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — CLEANING BUSINESS OPERATIONS

Full Time | Pacific Standard Time | Long-Term Position



WHO WE ARE



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions is a professional cleaning company

serving Los Angeles and the San Bernardino / Inland Empire markets

in Southern California. We handle residential and commercial

accounts. We use Jobber for all operations, Slack as our command

center, and QUO for phones. Everything runs through systems —

your job is to keep those systems moving every single day.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for a mature, experienced, dependable professional

with a minimum of 5 years of real work experience — ideally in

the cleaning industry, home services, or field service operations.



We need someone who has been through real workplace challenges

and knows how to handle them without hand-holding. Maturity,

professional stability, and reliability are more important to us

than anything else. If you are just starting out in your career

this is not the right position for you.



We have a small tight-knit team and are looking for someone who

will blend well with our existing team culture and take genuine

ownership of their role.



This is a long-term position with real growth opportunity.

If you show up, do the work correctly, and grow with us —

you will move up in this company. We promote from within.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



You MUST meet all of the following or do not apply:



  • Minimum 5 years of professional work experience

  • Currently working or has worked in Pacific Standard Time (PST)

    business hours — 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST — for at least 1 year

  • Previous experience working as a VA for a cleaning company,

    home services company, or field service business

  • Knows how to use Jobber or a similar field service CRM

    such as Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan

  • Fluent in English — written and spoken — professional level

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection

  • Quiet, professional workspace at home

  • Stable work history — no job hopping

  • Available to start within 2 weeks



???????????????????????????????????????????????



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW OR LEARN IMMEDIATELY



  • Jobber — quoting, booking, dispatching, invoicing

  • Slack — primary communication tool, you will live here

  • QUO / OpenPhone — answering calls and texts, managing inbox

  • Google LSA — responding to leads, managing the lead inbox

  • Microsoft 365 —
, SharePoint document management

  • PandaDoc — sending contracts and onboarding documents

  • Basic Zapier understanding is a plus



???????????????????????????????????????????????



YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Every single day you are responsible for:



LEAD MANAGEMENT

  • Monitor Google LSA inbox starting at 8:00 AM PST sharp

  • Respond to every new lead within 15 minutes of it coming in

  • Use the company pricing tool to generate accurate quotes

    every time — never guess a price

  • Follow up on all unanswered quotes within 24 hours

  • Log every lead in Slack #leads with lead ID and dollar amount



JOBBER OPERATIONS

  • Create new client profiles for every approved lead

  • Build and send quotes in Jobber using the correct templates

  • Convert approved quotes to jobs and schedule them correctly

  • Assign cleaners to jobs and confirm their availability first

  • Add complete job instructions including entry codes, parking,

    scope of work, and any special instructions

  • Monitor job status throughout the day — check-ins, completions

  • Follow up on any job that has not been marked complete on time



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

  • Respond to all client texts and calls through QUO professionally

  • Handle rescheduling, cancellations, and schedule changes

  • Escalate any client complaints to ownership immediately

  • Never discuss pricing changes or make promises without approval



SLACK ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Post your daily check-in by 8:00 AM PST every workday

  • Confirm every completed task in the assigned Slack channels

  • Respond to all Slack messages within 15 minutes during work hours

  • Post any issues, problems, or questions in the correct channel

    immediately — do not wait



CLEANER COORDINATION

  • Send job assignments to cleaners through Jobber

  • Follow up if a cleaner has not checked in within 15 minutes

    of their scheduled start time

  • Notify ownership immediately of any no-shows or problems

  • Send onboarding documents through PandaDoc to new cleaners

    and follow up until all documents are returned signed



???????????????????????????????????????????????



WHAT IS NOT ACCEPTABLE — READ THIS CAREFULLY



The following will result in immediate termination:



  • Not responding to leads within 15 minutes during work hours

  • Sending a quote with a price that was not generated from

    the company pricing tool

  • Missing the 8:00 AM PST daily check-in without prior notice

  • Not answering Slack messages during work hours

  • Making promises to clients without ownership approval

  • Logging off early without permission

  • Not logging leads, quotes, or completed tasks in Slack

  • Blaming cleaners or clients for errors that were your

    responsibility

  • Dishonesty of any kind — about tasks completed, client

    interactions, or cleaner performance



???????????????????????????????????????????????



HOURS AND SCHEDULE



  • Monday through Friday — 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST required

  • Saturday — 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM PST required

  • Sunday — occasional coverage may be needed

  • You are expected to be at your desk and available during

    all scheduled hours — not semi-available



This is a Pacific Standard Time role. If you cannot commit to

PST hours do not apply.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



PAY RATE



Starting rate: $4.50 to $6.00 USD per hour depending on

experience and Jobber knowledge.



Pay is weekly via Wise or direct transfer.



Performance reviews at 30 days and 90 days.

Raise available at 90 days for top performers.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are building this company for the long term. If you are

the right person — reliable, sharp, experienced, and genuinely

good at this — there is room to grow into a senior operations

role. We promote from within. The person who earns it gets more

responsibility, more pay, and a real career path with this company.



We are not looking for someone to do the bare minimum.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their role

and treats this business like it matters — because it does.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered you must include ALL of the following

in your application or it will not be reviewed:



  1. Your full name

  2. How many years of total professional work experience you have

  3. Confirm you are available 8 AM to 5 PM PST Monday through Saturday

  4. Describe your experience working for a cleaning company or

     home services business — be specific about what you did daily

  5. List every CRM or field service tool you have used

     such as Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan

  6. Tell us what PST time zone hours you have worked previously

     and for how long

  7. Write this exact sentence at the top of your application

     so we know you read the entire post:

     "I have read all requirements and I meet every one of them."



Applications that do not include all 7 items will not be reviewed.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions

Los Angeles, California

title: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Two Openings – No Experience Required
description:
JOB TITLE: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – No Experience Required



We are hiring a highly dependable virtual assistant to manage the daily operations of multiple eBay and Poshmark stores. Previous e-commerce experience is not required because complete training, written procedures, and detailed task checklists will be provided.



This position is only for someone who is reliable, learns quickly, follows instructions exactly, and takes their work seriously.



WORK SCHEDULE



Work begins promptly at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time every day.



This is not a flexible starting time. You must be clocked in, connected to the remote computer, and ready to begin working at exactly 6:00 AM.



You will continue working until all assigned daily responsibilities are completed correctly. The workload should normally take no more than eight hours, including for someone who is still learning.



The primary arrangement is for one virtual assistant to work every day, including weekends and holidays.



OPTIONAL TWO-PERSON ARRANGEMENT



If you would prefer to share the position with another reliable person, a two-person arrangement may be considered and must be approved in advance.



Under this arrangement:



One person would work four days and the other would work three days.



The following week, the schedules would switch.



Both people must complete the application and meet all requirements.



Both people must receive training and be capable of completing the job independently.



You would be responsible for coordinating the schedule and ensuring every day is covered.



Failure by either person to show up would not excuse unfinished work or leave the business without coverage.



A two-person arrangement is optional and is not guaranteed to be approved.



STRICT ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE POLICY



Reliability is the most important requirement for this position.



You may be removed from the position immediately if any of the following occurs:



You are late for a scheduled shift.



You miss a scheduled shift without prior approval.



You repeatedly request last-minute schedule changes.



You disappear, become unresponsive, or stop working while clocked in.



Your internet connection is too slow or unreliable to complete the work.



You repeatedly use internet, electricity, equipment, or personal problems as an excuse for unfinished work.



You fail to communicate immediately when a genuine emergency occurs.



You are unable or unwilling to learn the assigned procedures.



You repeatedly ask questions already answered in the training materials.



You ignore instructions or create your own process instead of following the required procedure.



You repeatedly make careless or preventable mistakes.



You fail to improve after receiving corrections.



You mark tasks as completed when they were not actually completed.



You clock in without actively working.



You falsify your clock-in time, clock-out time, completed tasks, screenshots, or reports.



You leave work unfinished without reporting it.



You fail to review your work before submitting it.



You send inaccurate, inappropriate, or unreviewed messages to customers.



You share passwords, remote-access information, customer information, or business information with anyone.



You perform unauthorized actions on an account.



You work another job or perform unrelated activities while clocked in.



You are consistently too slow after receiving reasonable training and practice.



You demonstrate that you cannot independently perform the job correctly.



Serious attendance, honesty, internet, communication, or performance problems may result in immediate termination without repeated warnings.



If it becomes clear that you cannot consistently show up on time, maintain a stable connection, learn the procedures, communicate properly, or complete the work accurately, the working relationship will be ended.



Do not apply unless you are confident that you can meet these expectations.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Your daily, weekly, and monthly duties will include:



Managing daily eBay and Poshmark operations.



Checking new orders and marking orders as shipped.



Placing customer orders accurately.



Adding and verifying tracking information.



Finding orders that are missing tracking or have not shipped on time.



Checking cancellations, requests, disputes, returns, and other customer cases.



Responding to customer messages, questions, comments, and offers.



Using ChatGPT to help create professional customer responses when needed.



Reviewing every ChatGPT-generated response for accuracy before sending it.



Checking account performance and account-health metrics.



Monitoring late-shipment rates and tracking-validation rates.



Confirming that stores remain within their listing limits.



Completing product research using ChatGPT and Product Hunter.



Preparing bulk product lists.



Confirming that enough products are available for the next day’s listings.



Completing at least 100 product-research items when assigned.



Checking and responding to customer offers.



Taking screenshots of eBay and Amazon orders when required.



Following pricing, quantity, inventory, and listing-management procedures.



Confirming that shipped orders receive the required price and quantity updates.



Checking store promotions, sales, handling times, and promoted-listing settings.



Checking for duplicate listings.



Moving listings between assigned categories when instructed.



Checking negative reviews and assisting with appeals.



Completing weekly and monthly store-maintenance tasks.



Updating order sheets and other operational records.



Following the specific written procedures for every assigned account and computer.



GOOGLE SHEET TRACKING



You will use a Google Sheet to manage and document your work.



You must:



Clock in at the beginning of every shift.



Clock out only after all assigned work is completed.



Check off every task only after it is actually completed.



Complete the required tasks for every assigned account or computer.



Leave clear notes when a task cannot be completed.



Report problems immediately instead of ignoring or skipping them.



Keep the tracker accurate throughout the shift.



Never mark an incomplete task as completed.



The tracker and remote computers will be reviewed. Dishonest clock-in information, false completion marks, misleading updates, or claiming work was completed when it was not may result in immediate termination.



COMPUTER AND INTERNET REQUIREMENTS



You will use your own computer to remotely access company computers.



You must have:



Your own dependable computer.



Fast and stable internet.



The ability to remotely access company computers.



A quiet and dependable place to work.



A reliable method of communication during every shift.



A backup internet option, such as mobile data or a hotspot, is strongly preferred.



Do not apply using slow, unstable, shared, or frequently disconnected internet. Internet problems that regularly interfere with attendance or work completion may result in immediate removal from the position.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS



No previous eBay, Poshmark, Amazon, or virtual-assistant experience is required.



You must have:



Strong written English.



Basic computer knowledge.



Excellent attention to detail.



The ability to learn new systems quickly.



The ability to follow detailed written instructions.



The ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately.



Strong communication skills.



The ability to work independently after training.



The ability to remain focused until the work is completed.



The ability to accept corrections and apply them immediately.



The discipline to review your own work before marking it complete.



The ability to ask questions when genuinely confused without repeatedly asking questions already answered during training.



USE OF CHATGPT



You may use ChatGPT to improve customer messages and assist with other approved tasks.



However, you remain fully responsible for anything you send or submit. You must read, understand, and verify every response before using it.



Copying and sending an incorrect, irrelevant, or inappropriate AI-generated response without reviewing it is unacceptable.



COMMUNICATION



Training, instructions, schedule coordination, questions, task updates, and daily reporting will take place through 
, WhatsApp, or text message.



You must remain responsive while clocked in.



Account problems, unusual orders, customer complaints, technical problems, and tasks you do not understand must be reported immediately.



Silence is not acceptable. If there is a problem, communicate it before it causes unfinished work or an account issue.



WHO SHOULD APPLY



This position is suitable for someone who is:



Dependable.



Honest.



Organized.



Patient.



Detail-oriented.



Comfortable with repetitive computer work.



Willing and able to learn.



Able to follow instructions without constant supervision.



Interested in stable, long-term work.



We care more about reliability, accuracy, communication, internet quality, and the ability to follow instructions than previous experience.



DO NOT APPLY IF:



You frequently arrive late.



You regularly miss work.



You have unreliable internet.



You cannot consistently begin working at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.

We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: YouTube Growth Specialist (Part-Time)
description:
I run an education channel on AI governance and tech career transitions, tied to a webinar-driven coaching business. I create and host all the videos myself; what I need is a specialist who owns everything around the content: strategy, packaging, optimization, and distribution, so the channel grows predictably instead of by luck.



This is a part-time, long-term role for someone who lives and breathes YouTube growth. You won’t be on camera or writing the teaching content; you’ll make that content perform.



What You’ll Own

• Channel & content strategy: keyword and trend research, competitive analysis, and a data-backed view of which topics and formats to make (I record them).

• Packaging: title and thumbnail strategy, concepts, and A/B testing to drive click-through.

• SEO & optimization: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end screens, cards, and playlists built for discovery.

• Publishing strategy: cadence, timing, premieres, and a Shorts plan that feeds the main channel.

• Analytics & iteration: track retention, CTR, and traffic sources; report what’s working and adjust the plan.

• Audience growth: community tab, comment-engagement strategy, and audience research.



I create and record every video. Your job is to grow the channel around them.

What You Bring

• A track record of growing a YouTube channel; ideally with before/after metrics you can show.

• Deep knowledge of YouTube SEO and how the algorithm surfaces content (browse, suggested, search).

• Packaging skill: titles and thumbnails that earn clicks, backed by testing.

• Fluency in YouTube Studio analytics; retention, CTR, and traffic sources.

• Thumbnail design ability or strong art direction (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).

• Data-driven instincts; you test, read the numbers, and iterate.

• Strong written English for titles, descriptions, and metadata.

Nice to Have

• Experience growing an education, info, or expert-led channel.

• A professional or B2B audience.

• Shorts growth experience.



Logistics

• Part-time, long-term, with room to grow as the channel does.

• Overlap with US Central business hours.

• Begins with a paid trial project so we can both assess fit.



How to Apply

Send me:

1. A short intro and why YouTube growth is your thing.

2. A channel you’ve grown; with before/after numbers if you have them.

3. A few examples: thumbnails or titles you’ve made, or an optimization you’re proud of.

4. Your availability.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid trial task: I’ll share one of my videos and a snapshot of the channel, and you’ll send (a) a packaging concept; title and thumbnail; and (b) three specific growth recommendations with your reasoning. How you think about the channel matters more to me than a polished résumé.

IMPORTANT: If you do not use AI tools as your primary design workflow, please do not apply. This role is built for AI-first designers only.



We are a growing Amazon brand team looking for one talented, fast-moving graphic designer to join us part-time. You'll be creating product images, A+ content, and storefronts for multiple brands, with room to grow into a full-time role.



All AI tools and software are provided by us, you just need the skills to use them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build A+ content modules and brand storefronts

• Use AI image generation tools as your primary workflow (we provide access)

• Use Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software to refine, edit, and polish final outputs

• You MUST use AI tools — this is not optional. We do not hire designers who rely solely on traditional tools.

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent software for basic to moderate image editing (masking, retouching, color correction, compositing)

• Experience creating Amazon product imagery (main images, A+ content, or storefronts)

• Speed — you need to produce quality work fast

• An eye for detail — you can spot what looks off in an AI output and fix it using your editing skills



NICE TO HAVE



• Understanding of Amazon image guidelines and listing requirements

• Portfolio showing AI-assisted commercial product work



WHAT WE OFFER



• Part-time hours (20–40 hrs/week) with potential to grow full-time

• $10/hour rate

• All tools and software provided

• Work across multiple growing brands

• Fast-paced, supportive team



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out our short form here: 



No resume needed right now — just complete the form and share your portfolio link. We'll be in touch with shortlisted candidates.

Actively recruiting candidates from multiple countries including the United States, Philippines, India, Latin America, and other markets

Proactively sourcing candidates through

Reporting progress clearly and regularly to leadership



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven recruiting or sourcing experience, please be completely honest about your background, we will verify

Experience using
 Groups and social platforms to find candidates

Strong Excel skills, you must be able to build and maintain your own tracking spreadsheet

Excellent written and spoken English, no exceptions

Someone who thrives hitting targets and takes quota seriously

High work ethic and a no-excuses attitude toward follow-through

A team player who communicates openly, flags issues early, and wants to be part of something long-term

Stable internet connection and a reliable work setup





WHAT YOU WILL GET



Consistent, long-term role with real growth potential

A team that actually cares about you and communicates with you

Clear expectations and metrics so you always know where you stand

Opportunity to grow into a senior recruiting or operations role as the company expands



A NOTE ON AI AND AUTOMATION

We do not accept AI-generated applications, AI-written outreach messages, or any form of automated recruiting. Every candidate touchpoint must be personal, human, and written by you. title: Accounts Clerk / Officer (Independent Contractor) – Remote, Philippines
description:
About Us



Furnware Group is an Australian company that design and manufacture the latest, most inspiring products, all backed by our lifetime warranty, satisfaction promise, and guaranteed on-time delivery.



We live the Furnware Way: an agile, inspired, and empowered team striving towards one goal, to make our customers' business better.



Furnware is proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified™ for our outstanding employee experience and workplace culture.



About the Opportunity



We're looking for a detail-driven Accounts Clerk/Officer to support our finance team on a 12-month independent contractor agreement, with options to renew. This is a predominantly accounts payable role, processing high volumes of transactions and supporting the broader finance function with AR, inventory, and reconciliation tasks.



Services are to be delivered during Furnware business hours to support effective team collaboration. This is a high-volume engagement requiring dedicated availability.



What You'll Be Doing



Accounts Payable: bill entry, supplier invoices and credits, payment batches (weekly and EOM), payable statement reconciliations, overseas invoice coordination, vendor returns, and bill approval management.

Accounts Receivable: responding to finance-related enquiries, debt collection, bank reconciliations, customer credits and returns, price adjustments, new credit account setups, and EOM tasks.

Inventory: landed cost allocation, clearing account balancing, and FX rate management.

 

About You



You're organised, accurate, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You take ownership of your work, ask the right questions, and bring a genuine willingness to learn and grow.



You'll have:



-An accounting qualification with a solid understanding of accounting fundamentals

-5+ years' experience in AP, AR or a similar accounts role

-Experience with high-volume AP processing, including bank reconciliations (circa 700 bills per month)

-Strong spoken English to confidently liaise with internal and external stakeholders

-Experience with mid-tier ERP such as NetSuite, Business Central or Acumatica or high end SAP, Oracle, or similar (NetSuite experience is a bonus but not essential)

-A hands-on approach and a team-first mindset

 

Contractor Details



This is an independent contractor arrangement. You will be required to:



-Provide your own equipment and IT setup, including reliable internet, power, and backups, to ensure uninterrupted service

-Maintain appropriate insurance for the duration of the contract

-Manage your own local tax, social security, and legal compliance obligations in the Philippines

 

What's in It for You



You'll be working alongside a high-performing finance team with a genuine focus on learning and development. As the engagement evolves, there is potential to broaden the scope of services provided and take on renewed terms.



The team you'll be collaborating with lives by these values: Simplify Everything, Spread the Energy, Sweat the Detail, Strive to Learn Together, and Stand by What's Right.



Apply today and bring your skills to a team that genuinely values what you do!

Essential Skills

* Motion graphics

* Professional typography

* Colour grading

* Sound design

* Social media editing

* Platform optimisation

* Organisation and file management

Bonus Skills

* 3D animation

* Sports brands

* Health brands

* Fitness brands

* Luxury brands

* Technology brands

* Performance marketing creatives







The ENGNE Standard



We don’t create average content.



We don’t rely on templates.



We don’t produce forgettable edits.



Every frame should have purpose.



Every transition should add value.



Every caption should feel designed.



Every animation should strengthen the story.



Every video should elevate the ENGNE brand.



Quality always comes before quantity.







What You’ll Receive



* Premium brand guidelines

* Logo files and brand assets

* High-quality raw footage from our production team

* Direct communication with the founders

* Creative freedom to help shape the brand

* Long-term opportunity to grow with the business







This Role Is For You If…



? You’re obsessed with creating outstanding content.



? You care about the smallest details.



? You enjoy storytelling.



? You study successful content online.



? You love solving creative challenges.



? You want to help build something meaningful.



? You take pride in your work.



? You bring ideas, not just edits.







This Role Isn’t For You If…



? You only know basic editing.



? You rely heavily on templates.



? You’re not confident using After Effects.



? You struggle to work independently.



? You regularly miss deadlines.



? You don’t enjoy receiving feedback.



? You produce average work and are happy with “good enough.”







Our Hiring Philosophy



We care far more about talent than years of experience.



If your portfolio is exceptional, we don’t mind whether you’ve worked for one client or one hundred.



We’re looking for creativity, taste, attention to detail and someone who genuinely wants to help build a world-class brand.



Show us your best work not your biggest client.







How To Apply



Please send us:



* Your portfolio or showreel

* Links to your three strongest edits

* Examples of your After Effects or motion graphics work

* A short introduction about yourself

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly rate (within our advertised range)



Please also answer the following questions:

3. Which edit are you most proud of, and what makes it special?

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.







Shortlisted Candidates



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing task using genuine ENGNE brand assets.



This gives us the opportunity to understand your creative thinking, storytelling ability and editing style.







Ready To Start?



We’re looking for someone who can start immediately.



Whether you’re looking for part-time or full-time work, we’re looking for the right person—not just someone to fill a position.



As ENGNE grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility and become a key part of our long-term creative team.







Final Message



We’re not looking for the fastest editor.



We’re looking for the one whose work people remember.



If you’re passionate about storytelling, obsessed with quality and want to help build one of the most exciting brands in men’s health from the ground up…



We’d love to hear from you.

title: DIGITAL MARKETING COORDINATOR
description:
About Us

TurnKey Auction & Real Estate is a Keller Williams team in Wichita, KS running both traditional real estate listings and live-bid property auctions through BidWichita. Our auction program is our competitive edge, and the marketing behind every auction is what determines how many bidders show up and what sellers walk away with.

We’re a lean, fast-moving team. We don’t have time to build someone from the ground up. We need a marketing professional who already knows the craft, can hit the ground running, and takes full ownership of the marketing function from Day 1.



Job Overview

You will own all of TurnKey’s digital marketing output. That means every listing launch, every auction campaign, every
 blast, every paid ad, every social media post — all of it is yours. You’re not supporting someone else’s marketing strategy. You are the marketing.

This role covers two content streams running simultaneously. First, listing and auction marketing. Second, brand and non-listing content: the monthly content calendar across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, farming postcard campaigns, seasonal mailers, and website maintenance.

If you’re someone who needs a lot of direction, check-ins, or hand-holding to figure out what to do next — this isn’t the right fit. If you’re someone who sees a gap, fills it, and reports back, keep reading.



Qualifications

• With hands-on digital marketing experience, with at least 1 year managing paid social media advertising campaigns independently — not assisting, owning.

• Proven experience managing Meta Ads Manager campaigns end-to-end: campaign setup, audience targeting, Housing Special Ad Category compliance, budget management, A/B testing, and performance optimization. housing violations are not recoverable mistakes in real estate.

• Demonstrated experience with
 marketing platforms — Mailjet, Flodesk, or equivalent. You can segment a list, build a sequence, schedule a campaign, and diagnose a deliverability problem.

• Strong Canva proficiency. You produce professional-quality real estate marketing graphics — listing announcements, open house posts, auction countdown graphics, Pending and Just Sold assets — without needing design direction on every piece.

• Video editing experience in CapCut or equivalent. You can produce short-form property walkthrough videos and social media Reels ready to post.

• Active, working knowledge of
 and Instagram business page management: publishing, boosting, community management, and brand voice consistency.

• LinkedIn page management experience. We want to grow our professional presence and referral network — this is not a secondary platform for us.

• YouTube channel management: video uploads, SEO-optimized titles and descriptions, thumbnail creation.

• Proficiency in Google Sheets for maintaining content calendars, marketing tracking sheets, and performance reporting.

• Real estate marketing experience is strongly preferred. Familiarity with MLS, listing lifecycles, transaction stages, and the difference between traditional listings and auction-based sales will significantly shorten your ramp time.

• Experience managing multiple concurrent campaigns across different properties, platforms, and content types simultaneously — without dropping balls.

• Strong analytical skills. You can read a performance report, identify what’s working and what isn’t, and make a recommendation.

• Excellent written English.

• Bilingual English/Spanish is strongly preferred. We serve the full Wichita metro and Spanish-language outreach is part of our growth strategy.



Remote Requirements

• Reliable high-speed internet connection capable of supporting simultaneous use of Meta Ads Manager, Canva, CapCut, Google Workspace, and video uploads without interruption.

• A personal computer capable of running design software, video editing tools, and multiple browser-based marketing platforms at the same time.

• 8 hours of daily overlap with Wichita, KS business hours (Central Standard/Daylight Time, UTC?6/UTC?5).

• Self-managed and self-directed. You track your own task queue, meet your own deadlines, and flag blockers before they become missed SLAs. We do weekly check-ins, not daily supervision.

• Comfortable with asynchronous communication via Google Chat, Google Drive, and
. You write clearly, you update shared documents proactively, and you don’t make your teammates chase you for status updates.

• Backup internet or power solution in place.



Skill Requirements



Must have at hire

• Meta Ads Manager — campaign creation, budget management, performance optimization

•
 marketing platform (Mailjet preferred) — list segmentation, campaign scheduling, deliverability management, A/B testing

• Canva — professional graphic design for real estate marketing, consistent brand application

• CapCut or equivalent video editor — short-form video, Reels, property walkthroughs

•
 and Instagram Business Manager — organic posting, paid boosting, community management

• LinkedIn Business Page — professional content, brand presence, audience growth

• YouTube Studio — video uploads, titles, descriptions, thumbnails, channel management

• Google Sheets — content calendars, leads tracking, performance reporting

• Paid social advertising — campaign strategy, audience targeting, creative testing, ROI tracking

• Social media content calendar management — multi-platform, multi-listing, simultaneous execution

• Brand voice execution — writing in a defined tone without deviation across all content types

• Marketing analytics and performance reporting — reading data, drawing conclusions, making recommendations



Strongly preferred

• Real estate marketing experience — MLS, listing lifecycle, transaction stages, auction-based sales

• KW Command — landing page creation, Ads reporting, leads management

• SMS marketing platform experience (Quo or equivalent)

• Bilingual English/Spanish content creation — social posts,
 campaigns, farming materials

• Multi-listing campaign management

• CRM experience — contact management, lead tracking, campaign tagging

• Farming and direct mail coordination — postcard campaigns, seasonal mailers, vendor management

• Google Analytics — website traffic, campaign attribution, conversion tracking

• A/B testing — ads,
 subject lines, landing pages

• WordPress or similar CMS — website listing updates, content maintenance



What we’re really looking for underneath the skills

Someone who treats our listings like their own business. Someone who notices that an ad is underperforming and adjusts it without waiting for check-in. Someone who reads the brand guide once and applies it correctly every time. Someone who sees the auction clock counting down and makes sure every bidder on the list has been reached. Someone who takes pride in the work not because they’re watched, but because their name is on it.

Help Us Bring Hope and Healing to Thousands Around the World



Do you love creating meaningful social media content?

Are you skilled with Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, and short-form video creation? 

Would you enjoy helping build a Christian ministry dedicated to emotional healing, healthy relationships, and hope after heartbreak?

 If so, we'd love to hear from you.





ABOUT US:



Healed To Love Again is a Christian ministry committed to helping people heal from heartbreak, recover emotionally, strengthen their faith, and prepare for healthier future relationships.



Through social media, books, podcasts, articles, and other digital resources, we share practical and biblically grounded encouragement with people around the world.



As our ministry grows, we're looking for someone who can become an important part of our long-term content team.





ABOUT THE POSITION 



This Is NOT a Traditional Virtual Assistant Role



We are not looking for someone to simply upload posts or perform administrative tasks.



Instead, we're looking for someone who can take our ideas and transform them into engaging, high-quality social media content.



Think of yourself as part of our **Content Production Team**.



You won't be expected to invent our message.



Our founders will provide:



* Weekly content topics

* Key teaching points

* Supporting Bible verses

* Emotional direction

* Brand guidelines



Your role is to transform those ideas into beautiful, engaging content.







WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK 



Every Monday, you'll attend a short planning meeting where you'll receive five content topics for the week.

For each topic, you'll create:



? One short-form Reel 
 / Instagram / TikTok)

? One quote graphic in Canva

? One social media post

? One Story sequence



After approval, you'll:



* Schedule content across our platforms

* Organize project files

* Update the content calendar

* Prepare a simple weekly analytics report



You'll also help us improve our content system over time by suggesting workflow improvements and using tools effectively.







TOOLS YOU'LL USE 



We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI and modern content creation tools.



Preferred experience includes:



* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

* Google Drive

* Meta Business Suite

* TikTok Scheduler



Experience with Notion or Trello is a bonus.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 



We're looking for someone who is:



* Creative

* Organized

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable using AI

* Willing to learn

* Able to meet deadlines

* Open to feedback

* Interested in building long-term systems rather than simply completing tasks





REQUIRED SKILLS



* Excellent written English

* Canva

* CapCut

* Basic graphic design

* Short-form video editing

* Social media copywriting

* ChatGPT prompting

* Content organization







BONUS SKILLS 

Experience creating content for:



* Christian ministries

* Coaches

* Authors

* Personal brands

* Relationship or mental wellness organizations



is an advantage but not required.





OUR BRAND VOICE

Everything we publish should communicate:



* Hope

* Compassion

* Wisdom

* Grace

* Emotional intelligence

* Biblical truth



We avoid:



* Shaming people

* Harsh criticism

* Clickbait

* Cynicism

* Sensationalism



Our goal is not simply to create viral content.

Our goal is to genuinely help people heal.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 



Every Friday, the following should be ready:



? 5 completed Reels

? 5 quote graphics

? 5 social media posts

? 5 Story sequences

? All content scheduled

? Organized project files

? Weekly analytics summary



As our systems improve, you'll also help us make our content production faster, smarter, and more efficient.





TRAINING & SUPPORT



You won't be starting from scratch.

We've already built detailed systems that you'll receive, including:



* Brand Guidelines

* Content Production SOPs

* Weekly Content Briefs

* AI Prompt Library

* Canva Templates

* CapCut Templates

* Content Calendar

* Workflow Documentation



Our goal is to help you succeed by providing clear systems and expectations.





COMPENSATION

* Part-time position

* Approximately 5–6 hours per week

* Competitive hourly rate based on experience



There is opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the ministry grows.





OUR HIRING PROCESS 



--- Stage 1 – Application



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A link to your portfolio or examples of your work.



Examples may include:



* Reels

* Short-form videos

* Canva graphics

* Social media pages you've managed



3. Briefly tell us about your experience using:



* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

*

* Instagram

* TikTok



4. In 200 words or less:



**How has AI changed the way you create content?**





--- Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical assignment** based on a real content topic from our ministry.



This assignment is designed to reflect the actual work involved in the role.



Selected candidates will be compensated for their time.







--- Stage 3 – Interview



Finalists will participate in a short interview to discuss:



* Communication

* Organization

* Workflow

* Long-term goals

* Cultural fit







--- Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week



The successful candidate will complete a paid trial week, working through our real content production process.



This gives both you and our team the opportunity to determine whether we're a good long-term fit for one another.





PLEASE BE SURE TO INCLUDE THE PHRASE "HIRING DEPARTMENT" within the subject of your application.



Why Join Us?



This is more than a freelance content role.



It's an opportunity to help build a ministry that brings hope, healing, and biblical encouragement to people navigating some of life's most difficult seasons.



If you're excited about creating meaningful content, leveraging AI to work smarter, and growing with a mission-driven team, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Senior Laravel ERP Software Engineer (Accounting / Business Systems)
description:
About Us



Injazat Information Technology is a Saudi Arabian software company established in 2003.



We develop business-critical SaaS applications including:



* Real Estate Management

* Human Resources (HR)

* Payroll

* Financial Accounting



Our flagship Real Estate SaaS is a mature Laravel + Vue application with integrated accounting, VAT, financial reporting, lease management, owner accounting, contracts, installments, and many years of business logic.



We are looking for a senior developer who enjoys understanding complex business systems rather than building simple CRUD applications.



---



The Role



This is **not** a greenfield development position.



You will gradually take ownership of an existing Laravel + Vue SaaS application by:



* Understanding an existing codebase developed over many years.

* Learning complex business rules.

* Completing unfinished modules.

* Fixing production issues.

* Improving maintainability.

* Working closely with our senior developers.

* Becoming a long-term technical owner of the platform.



---



Essential Technical Skills



* Laravel (5+ years preferred)

* PHP

* MySQL

* Vue.js / Vue 3

* REST APIs

* Git

* Debugging complex production systems



Experience with:



* Unit testing

* Automated testing

* CI/CD

* Performance optimization



is highly desirable.



---



Business System Experience (Highly Preferred)



We are particularly interested in developers who have worked on one or more of the following:



* ERP systems

* Accounting software

* Payroll systems

* Financial systems

* Property Management systems

* Real Estate software

* Inventory systems

* Subscription platforms

* Enterprise SaaS applications



---



Accounting Knowledge



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



* General Ledger

* Journal Posting

* Trial Balance

* Balance Sheet

* Income Statement

* Accounts Receivable

* Accounts Payable

* Payroll

* VAT / Tax calculations

* Financial reconciliation



You do **not** need to be an accountant, but you should be comfortable understanding financial workflows and business rules.



---



What We Are Looking For



Someone who enjoys:



* Reading existing code before making changes.

* Understanding business rules.

* Finding root causes instead of temporary fixes.

* Preventing regressions through testing.

* Maintaining production software.

* Working on applications that customers depend on every day.



---



Not the Right Position If You Prefer



* Building new projects from scratch only.

* Frequent technology changes.

* Mostly frontend/UI work.

* Short-term freelance engagements.



---



Our Technology Stack



* Laravel

* Vue.js

* MySQL

* REST APIs

* Bootstrap

* Git

* Linux



---



Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates will complete a **paid technical assessment** based on a real module from our application.



The assessment focuses on:



* Understanding an existing codebase.

* Business logic analysis.

* Debugging.

* Safe implementation of enhancements.

* Code quality.



---



When Applying



Please include:



1. A brief description of the largest business application you have worked on.

2. Your experience with accounting or ERP software (if any).

3. Examples of production systems you have maintained.

4. Your expected hourly rate.

5. Your weekly availability.

6. Links to your GitHub or portfolio.



We value honesty. If you have not worked on accounting software before, simply tell us. We are looking for developers who can learn, communicate well, and take ownership of a complex application over the long term.



Describe the most complex business application you have maintained.



What did the system do? What business rules made it complex? What was your personal contribution? Describe one production bug you investigated, how you found the root cause, and how you ensured it did not reoccur.

title: Ongoing SEO Specialist for Leading UK Wedding Entertainment Brand
description:
About the business



Secret Service Singers is an established UK wedding and events entertainment company specialising in surprise singing waiter performances.



We have delivered thousands of performances, built a strong brand and won multiple industry awards. We are now looking for an experienced SEO specialist to significantly increase our organic visibility, website traffic and qualified wedding enquiries throughout the UK.



This is not a one-off SEO audit. We are looking for someone who can build and execute a long-term SEO strategy, with the objective of ranking our website on the first page of Google for valuable commercial searches related to singing waiters and wedding entertainment.



The objective



Your primary objective will be to increase our rankings, qualified organic traffic and genuine customer enquiries.



Priority search themes will include terms such as:



Singing waiters

Singing waiters UK

Surprise singing waiters

Singing waiters for weddings

Wedding singing waiters

Surprise wedding entertainment

Wedding entertainment ideas

Unique wedding entertainment

Singing waiters near me

Location-based singing waiter searches across major UK towns, cities and regions



We understand that legitimate SEO takes time and that nobody can honestly guarantee a specific Google ranking. However, we expect a clear strategy, consistent implementation, measurable progress and complete transparency.



Responsibilities



The successful candidate will be responsible for:



SEO strategy

Conducting a full audit of our current website and organic presence

Reviewing our competitors and identifying opportunities they are currently using

Creating a detailed 6 to 12-month SEO strategy

Identifying high-value commercial keywords with genuine booking potential

Prioritising work based on likely traffic, conversion potential and difficulty

Creating a realistic roadmap towards first-page rankings

Technical SEO

Auditing and improving website crawlability and indexation

Resolving broken links, redirect issues and duplicate content

Reviewing XML sitemaps and robots.txt

Improving website structure and URL structure

Implementing appropriate schema markup

Improving Core Web Vitals, mobile performance and page speed

Identifying problems through Google Search Console

Ensuring important pages are correctly indexed

Monitoring the website for technical errors

On-page SEO

Optimising titles, meta descriptions, headings and website copy

Improving existing service pages

Creating an effective internal linking structure

Improving image filenames, compression and alternative text

Strengthening the topical relevance of our website

Preventing keyword cannibalisation

Improving pages for both search rankings and customer conversions

Content strategy

Creating a content plan based on customer search behaviour

Producing detailed briefs for new pages and articles

Developing valuable wedding entertainment content rather than generic AI-generated articles

Identifying useful FAQs and informational searches

Updating existing content where improvements would produce faster results

Planning high-quality city, county and regional landing pages

Ensuring location pages are genuinely useful and not duplicated doorway pages

Local and national SEO

Improving our visibility for searches throughout the UK

Developing a safe and effective location-page strategy

Optimising our Google Business Profile where appropriate

Improving legitimate local citations and business information

Identifying regional wedding publications and partnership opportunities

Helping the brand compete nationally while targeting specific high-value locations

Authority and backlinks

Developing a safe, high-quality link acquisition strategy

Identifying relevant wedding venues, wedding blogs, suppliers, publications and industry websites

Conducting genuine outreach and digital PR

Reviewing existing backlinks and identifying potentially harmful links

Building authority through relevant editorial coverage and partnerships



We are not interested in bulk backlink packages, private blog networks, automated links, spam directories or any tactic that could damage the brand.



Tracking and reporting

Correctly setting up or reviewing Google Analytics 4

Reviewing Google Search Console

Tracking keyword rankings

Tracking enquiry form submissions, telephone calls and other conversions

Reporting on organic traffic and qualified leads

Providing a clear monthly report explaining:

Work completed

Ranking changes

Traffic changes

Enquiries and conversions

Technical issues found

Priorities for the following month



Reports must be clear and understandable. We do not want reports filled with statistics that do not connect to bookings or revenue.



Essential experience



Applicants must have:



Proven SEO experience with UK service businesses

Experience achieving strong rankings in competitive markets

Strong technical SEO knowledge

Experience with local and national SEO

Experience using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console

Experience with keyword research and competitor analysis

Experience creating location-based SEO strategies

An understanding of conversion-focused website optimisation

Excellent written English

Clear and reliable communication



Experience within weddings, events, entertainment, hospitality or another lead-generation industry would be highly beneficial.



What we do not want



Please do not apply if your strategy mainly involves:



Buying hundreds of backlinks

Publishing large amounts of low-quality AI content

Keyword stuffing

Copying competitor articles

Creating duplicate location pages

Automated directory submissions

Making changes without explaining them

Promising guaranteed number-one rankings

Sending generic reports without demonstrating business results



All significant website changes must be explained and approved before implementation.



Initial project



The first stage will include:



A complete technical and on-page SEO audit

Competitor analysis

Keyword and search-intent research

An assessment of our current backlinks

A review of our existing website structure and content

A prioritised 90-day action plan

A proposed 6 to 12-month growth strategy

Recommendations for tracking rankings, enquiries and revenue



Following this initial stage, we are looking for continued monthly work implementing and managing the strategy.



Performance expectations



We will assess success using:



Improvements in rankings for commercially valuable searches

Growth in non-branded organic traffic

Increased visibility across UK locations

Increased qualified enquiries

Increased bookings generated through organic search

Improvements in website conversion rates

Growth in relevant referring domains and brand authority



Traffic alone is not the objective. We want people who are actively considering booking wedding entertainment.



Application requirements



Please include the following in your application:



A brief explanation of how you would approach SEO for a UK singing waiter and wedding entertainment company.

Two or three relevant examples of websites you have worked on.

Evidence of ranking, traffic or lead-generation improvements.

An explanation of exactly what work you personally completed.

The SEO tools you use.

Your preferred monthly working arrangement and availability.

Your estimated timeline for the audit and initial strategy.

What information or access you would require from us.

Your approach to backlinks and digital PR.

How you measure whether SEO is generating genuine enquiries and revenue.



Please begin your application with the words “Secret Service SEO” so we know you have read the full description.



Important application question



After briefly reviewing our industry, tell us:



Which three keyword areas you would prioritise first

Who you believe our main organic competitors are

The first three SEO improvements you would investigate



Generic or copy-and-paste applications will not be considered.



Working relationship



This is intended to become an ongoing relationship with the right person.



We are prepared to pay properly for proven skill, strategic thinking and measurable work. We are not searching for the lowest-cost applicant. However, we expect excellent value, honest communication and clear accountability.



Please provide either:



Your proposed monthly retainer and what it includes, or

Your hourly rate and estimated monthly hours



There is potential for continued long-term work as the business grows.

title: AI Editor
description:
AI Ad Creative — UGC Video, AI Animation & Static Ads



We're a creative agency that produces short-form ad creative for

direct-to-consumer brands. We run a high volume of video and static ads

across Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok for multiple clients, and we

need an AI creative who can take a brief and turn it into finished,

scroll-stopping ads — fast, and across different brand styles.



This is a hands-on production role. You'll work on several brands at once,

so you need to switch gears quickly and keep quality high under deadlines.

If you love AI creative tools and get a kick out of making ads that

actually convert, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form UGC video ads for Meta & TikTok (hooks, captions,

pacing, B-roll, music, sound design)

- Generate AI UGC videos using avatar tools (HeyGen or similar)

- Create AI animation / motion clips for product and explainer ads

(Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Design static picture ads and variations (Nano Banana / Gemini,

Midjourney, Photoshop, Canva)

- Adapt to each client's brand style, voice, and guidelines

- Produce multiple variations of winning ads for testing

- Add AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) and clean, readable captions

- Keep assets organized and labeled per client

- Juggle multiple brands and hit weekly output quotas



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ year editing short-form video (CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects)

- Hands-on with at least a few AI creative tools — any of: HeyGen, Veo,

Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini, ElevenLabs

- A real eye for what makes someone stop scrolling (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Can switch between different brand styles without losing quality

- Fast, reliable, communicates every day

- Follows briefs exactly and asks questions when something's unclear

- Good written English

- A computer that can handle editing + stable internet



BONUS POINTS

- Agency or direct-response / DTC ad experience

- You can design statics AND edit video

- You know Meta Ads specs and what a winning ad looks like

- You can write your own hooks and captions



HOURS & SETUP

- Starts part-time (around 15–20 hrs/week) and grows to full-time as our

client load increases and you prove you're a fit

- This is a grow-into-it role: start small, earn more hours

- 100% remote

- Some overlap with US hours preferred



PAY

- Starting rate TBD — based on experience and hours (we'll discuss it

in the interview)

- Reviewed after 90 days + performance bonuses for ads that win



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we ignore copy-paste applications)

1. Change the subject line to: "I make scroll-stopping AI ads"

2. Send your portfolio or 2–3 sample ads (video and/or static)

3. List which AI tools you've actually used and what you made with each

4. Tell us in one sentence what makes a short-form ad stop the scroll

5. Tell us your expected rate to start (part-time) — per hour or per month



Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.

title: Content Strategist
description:
SHOOT & SCALE

Social Media Marketing Agency

 

Content Fulfillment Manager

Full-Time · Remote ·

Location

(Remote)

Employment Type

Full-Time — 40 Hours/Week

Languages Required

English

Department

Fulfillment

Reports To

Founder / CEO

Compensation 

Starting at $750-$1250/month 



 

About Shoot & Scale

Shoot & Scale is a fast-growing social media marketing agency specializing in short-form content for service-based businesses. We help brands build awareness, grow their audience, and generate leads through strategic content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. We work with a tight-knit team that moves fast, cares deeply about quality, and is obsessed with results.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and highly organized Content Fulfillment Manager to lead the fulfillment side of our agency. This is not a junior position — you will own the entire client fulfillment pipeline, from content strategy and scripting to QA and client communication. You will be the main point of contact ensuring every client receives outstanding, on-brand content on time, every time.

 

If you eat, sleep, and breathe short-form content — if you understand why a hook works, how a format drives retention, and what makes a viewer stop scrolling — this role was built for you.

 

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Scripting

•       Develop and execute monthly content strategies for multiple clients across service-based niches

•       Write compelling short-form video scripts tailored to each client’s voice, audience, and goals

•       Select and apply the right formats, hooks, and topics for each piece of content

•       Review and revise scripts based on client feedback, ensuring brand alignment and quality on every round

•       Stay ahead of trends, viral formats, and emerging hooks across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

 

Client Communication & Fulfillment

•       Serve as the primary fulfillment contact for all clients — send scripts, collect feedback, and manage revision rounds

•       Keep clients informed and confident at every stage of the content process

•       Maintain clear timelines and ensure all deliverables are sent on schedule

•       Handle client revisions promptly and professionally, incorporating feedback without losing creative quality

 

Video QA & Creative Direction

•       Review all video edits produced by our editing team before delivery to clients

•       Provide detailed, specific QA notes on pacing, captions, visual hooks, B-roll, transitions, and overall look-and-feel

•       Ensure every video is polished, on-brand, and meets Shoot & Scale’s quality standards

•       Develop and refine internal QA checklists and editing briefs to raise the bar consistently

 

Fulfillment Department Leadership

•       Own the fulfillment department end-to-end — systems, workflows, quality, and output

•       Identify bottlenecks and proactively build processes that keep the team efficient and clients happy

•       Work closely with the founding team to improve and scale fulfillment operations

 

What We’re Looking For

Content Knowledge & Skills

•       Deep understanding of short-form video content: hooks, formats, topics, visual hooks, and content strategy

•       Proven ability to write scripts that are engaging, clear, and built to perform

•       Strong eye for design, aesthetics, and video quality — you notice what looks off instantly

•       Familiarity with content performance principles and what drives views, saves, and shares

 

Communication & Language

•       Fully English — written and spoken, professional level in both

•       Comfortable communicating with clients in English

•       Clear, professional, and warm communicator — clients should feel taken care of

 

Work Style & Mindset

•       Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you juggle multiple clients without dropping the ball

•       Self-directed and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what needs fixing

•       High standards for your own work and for the work that goes out under your name

•       Comfortable in a fast-paced, growing agency environment where things evolve quickly

•       Reliable internet and availability during standard business hours

 

Nice to Have

•       Prior experience at a social media marketing or content agency

•       Experience with CapCut, Canva, or similar tools for reviewing and annotating edits

•       Familiarity with project management tools (GoHighLevel, Asana, Frame.io, etc.)

•       Experience working with service-based business clients (coaches, consultants, agencies, etc.)

 

What You’ll Get

•       Fully remote position — work from anywhere

•       40 hours/week with a stable, long-term engagement

•       A clear ownership role — you’re not a cog, you run the department

•       A collaborative, growth-oriented team that values your ideas and initiative

•       The opportunity to build systems, grow a team, and shape fulfillment operations as the agency scales

 

How to Apply

To apply, please send the following to 

 

•       Your resume or LinkedIn profile

•       A short video (60–120 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why you’re the right fit for this role

•       Two examples of short-form video content you’ve scripted or strategized (links preferred)

•       A brief answer (3–5 sentences) to this question: “What makes a great hook, and how do you decide which hook to use for a given piece of content?”

 

Applications without the video introduction will not be reviewed. We want to see how you communicate — this is a client-facing role.

 

Shoot & Scale · 

Short-Form Content That Grows Service Brands.
