title: Remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager for Hawaii Prefab Company
description:
Paa Prefab is a growing prefab housing and building-products company on the Big Island of Hawaii. We sell prefab buildings, storage and office units, container-style spaces, and related building products for customers who need practical, affordable space.



I am hiring a remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager to help run the parts of the company that need consistent follow-through, organization, reporting, research, and systems.



This role is for someone who can take ownership across multiple areas of the business: finance admin, marketing coordination, sales follow-up, procurement research, customer communication, supplier tracking, project organization, and internal systems.



I am looking for someone who can operate independently, solve problems, create structure, maintain standards, and make the business easier to run without needing constant hand-holding.



You will work directly with the owner. Your job is to own the operating rhythm of the business, keep work moving, surface decisions clearly, and reduce the number of things that fall back on the owner.



Financial, marketing, and sales as well as management success, a hunger and will to succeed, strong problem solving, and the track-record to prove it.



Core Areas You Will Help Own



Finance and Regulatory Admin



You will help keep the business financially organized and legally in compliance of tax and other accounting requirements.



This may include:



 • Organizing invoices, receipts, quotes, payments, and vendor records.

 • Researching required State, Federal Tax and other required reporting/submissions on time.

 • Tracking customer deposits, balances due, payment status, and follow-up needs.

 • Preparing simple finance summaries for owner review.

 • Coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, or outside finance support.

 • Flagging missing documents, unpaid balances, unusual charges, or unclear records.

 • Helping prepare clean records for taxes, bookkeeping, and reporting.



You will not be expected to make final financial decisions without approval, but you should be able to keep the finance admin side organized and visible.



Sales Operations



You will help make sure leads and customers do not fall through the cracks.



This may include:



 • Managing CRM records and lead pipelines.

 • Tracking every lead’s status and next step.

 • Drafting customer replies and follow-up messages.

 • Preparing quote information for owner review.

 • Making sure customer questions get answered or escalated.

 • Tracking interested customers, serious buyers, quote requests, deposits, and delivery status.

 • Identifying which leads need urgent attention.



The goal is not just to reply to messages. The goal is to help build a reliable sales follow-up system.



Marketing Coordination



You will help keep marketing organized and active.



This may include:



 • Coordinating
 Marketplace listings and social media posts.

 • Organizing product photos, descriptions, pricing notes, and listing copy.

 • Tracking which products are listed where.

 • Watching competitor listings and local market pricing.

 • Helping draft ads, posts, flyers,
s, and simple marketing campaigns.

 • Tracking which marketing channels are producing leads.

 • Suggesting improvements based on what customers are asking about.



Marketing should be practical, consistent, and safe for the business. No spam tactics, fake accounts, risky shortcuts, or sloppy public claims.



Procurement and Supplier Research



You will help research and organize supplier options.



This may include:



 • Researching prefab buildings, container units, sheds, storage units, roofing systems, panels, accessories, tools, materials, and related products.

 • Comparing suppliers, pricing, shipping, minimum order quantities, lead times, and product specs.

 • Organizing supplier quotes and conversations.

 • Preparing comparison summaries.

 • Asking suppliers clear questions.

 • Tracking open supplier issues and follow-ups.

 • Helping identify better products, better margins, or better sourcing options.



The goal is to help the owner make faster, better purchasing decisions.



Operations and Project Coordination



You will help turn messy daily business activity into clear systems.



This may include:



 • Creating trackers, checklists, SOPs, templates, dashboards, and simple workflows.

 • Preparing daily and weekly owner updates.

 • Tracking open decisions, blockers, customer promises, supplier follow-ups, and delivery issues.

 • Organizing documents, photos, product details, quotes, invoices, contracts, and project records.

 • Keeping important information easy to find.

 • Noticing repeated problems and suggesting fixes.



The strongest person for this role will not wait for every task to be assigned. They will notice what is missing and help create order.



Looking For: Strong General Manager Traits



I am looking for someone who is:



 • Excellent in written English.

 • Highly organized and reliable.

 • Calm under pressure.

 • Graceful and professional at all times, with customers, vendors, and coworkers.

 • A self-starter who does not need to be chased.

 • Comfortable owning several business areas at once.

 • Good at turning messy information into clear next steps.

 • Strong at follow-up, reminders, tracking, and documentation.

 • Able to maintain business standards even when things are moving quickly.

 • Able to make practical recommendations, not just collect information.

 • Comfortable making judgment calls and explaining your reasoning.

 • Careful with customer promises, pricing, permitting, delivery details, and anything that could create confusion.

 • Honest when you do not know something.

 • Able to work independently while keeping the owner informed.

 • Practical, direct, and action-oriented.



The strongest candidate will think like a general manager, chief of staff, or operations lead — someone who sees what needs to happen, organizes it, and helps make it happen.



Looking For: Useful Experience



Direct construction experience is helpful, but it is not required.



I am interested in people who have managed complexity in real business environments. Strong candidates may come from many backgrounds, including:



 • Operations management for a small business.

 • Finance admin, bookkeeping coordination, invoice tracking, or payment follow-up.

 • Sales operations, CRM management, lead follow-up, or quote coordination.

 • Marketing coordination, social media listings, Marketplace, paid ads, or local business marketing.

 • Procurement, supplier research, vendor management, importing, shipping, or product comparison.

 • Logistics, dispatch, delivery coordination, warehouse coordination, or inventory management.

 • Trades businesses, contractor offices, repair businesses, mechanical services, equipment rental, automotive, marine, appliance, solar, or other hands-on service businesses.

 • Real estate, property management, hospitality, events, or other high-pressure customer-facing operations.

 • Coordinating many moving parts across customers, vendors, schedules, documents, and money records.

 • CRM tools, Airtable, HubSpot, Notion, Trello, Linear, Google Sheets, or similar systems.

 • Working for a US, Australian, Canadian, or UK business.

 • ChatGPT or other AI tools used for real business operations.

 • Building trackers, dashboards, checklists, SOPs, or simple systems for a growing company.



What matters most is not the exact industry. What matters is whether you can manage complexity, maintain standards, communicate clearly, and keep moving with calm, charm, and good judgment.



Looking For: Work Style



The business moves fast. Some things will be messy. Your job is to help make them clear.

I value short, useful updates. I do not need long vague reports. I want information that helps decisions happen faster.



Looking For: AI Tool Judgment



I want someone who can use AI tools well, but not blindly.



Good AI use means:



 • Using ChatGPT to draft, summarize, organize, compare, and speed up research.

 • Checking facts before relying on them.

 • Editing AI output so it sounds human, specific, and accurate.

 • Knowing when a customer-facing message needs owner approval.

 • Separating facts, assumptions, and open questions.

 • Never using AI as an excuse for sloppy work or for a lack of accountability for the work you do.



How To Apply



Please reply with:



 1 A short introduction in your own words.

 2 Your relevant experience.

 3 Why you think you are a fit for a General Manager / Business Operations Manager role.

 4 Your expected monthly salary in USD.

 5 Your available working hours in Philippine time.

 6 Your available overlap with Hawaii time, if you know it.

 7 A specific example of a messy process, tracker, system, or workflow you improved.

 8 A specific example of a time you solved a business problem without waiting for your boss to tell you every step.

 9 A specific example of a time you stayed calm and effective in a fast-moving or high-pressure situation.

 10 Which areas you are strongest in: finance admin, marketing, sales operations, procurement, customer follow-up, project coordination, systems, logistics, vendor management, or research.

 11 What tools you are comfortable with: spreadsheets, CRM, Google Workspace, ChatGPT, Notion, Airtable, Trello, etc.



Please also answer these questions:



Question 1:

A potential customer asks about a prefab home but gives incomplete information. What information would you collect before the owner spends time preparing a quote?



Question 2:

A customer asks: “Can I live in this? Is it permitted? I’m in Puna and need something cheap fast.” How would you reply?



Question 3:

You notice that leads are coming from
, text messages, phone calls, and referrals, but there is no reliable system for tracking who needs follow-up. What would you build first?



Question 4:

You are researching a new supplier. What information would you collect before recommending whether we should consider buying from them?



Question 5:

Describe a business environment where you had to manage many moving parts at once. What standards did you maintain, and how did you keep things from falling through the cracks?



Optional: Tell me how you currently use ChatGPT or AI tools in your work, and how you check the output before using it.



Applications that are generic, copy-pasted, or obviously AI-written without personal detail will be skipped.



Paid Test Task



Strong applicants may be invited to complete a short paid test task before hiring.



The test may include:



 • Creating a lead follow-up tracker.

 • Drafting a customer follow-up message.

 • Creating a quote-prep checklist.

 • Summarizing supplier/product options.

 • Writing a daily owner update.

 • Creating a basic finance/admin tracker for invoices, deposits, balances due, and missing records.

 • Recommending a simple operating system for managing leads, suppliers, quotes, marketing tasks, and follow-ups.

 • Explaining which customer, finance, pricing, permitting, or public-facing issues should require owner approval.



I am looking for judgment, clarity, structure, independence, follow-through, calm under pressure, and practical thinking.



Compensation



This is a serious full-time role.



Pay is USD $2,000/month for the right person.



I am willing to pay well for someone who is independent, reliable, organized, calm, honest, and able to take ownership of finance admin, sales operations, marketing coordination, procurement research, logistics support, vendor follow-up, and business systems so the company can run with less owner involvement.

s inside Klaviyo,

title: Looking for an Elite AMV / Beat Sync Video Editor (CapCut) | Cinematic Music Video Project
description:
This is NOT your typical AMV edit.



I'm looking for a highly skilled video editor who wants to work on a cinematic music video unlike anything you've probably edited before.



While this project isn't anime, I believe the best AMV editors are uniquely qualified for it because of their attention to detail, beat synchronization, motion design, camera movement, and ability to create emotion through editing.



If you're someone who enjoys pushing your editing skills beyond standard anime edits and wants to create something visually unforgettable, I'd love to hear from you.



About the Project



The project is an original cinematic house music video called Skarnax.



The story follows a colossal, warship-sized seagull deity that descends from the heavens and attacks an isolated 1800s fishing village. As the music reaches the drop, Skarnax unleashes chaos across the sea and nearby city before mysteriously disappearing, leaving behind only one message...



He will return.



I have already created the full AI-generated storyboard and reference video.



Your job is to take the visuals to an entirely new level through professional editing.



What You'll Be Working With



I'll provide everything you need, including:



Complete AI-generated reference video

Character PNGs (multiple attack poses)

City backgrounds

Ocean backgrounds

Sky backgrounds

Flying ship PNGs

Flying debris PNGs

Crowd PNGs

Smoke, waves and environmental assets

Music track

Beat markers already synchronized to the kick drum

Additional overlay assets



You are NOT creating assets from scratch.



Your job is to transform these assets into an exciting cinematic sequence.



The Demo



Instead of asking you to complete the entire project, I first want a 5-second demo.



The demo begins at the 25-second mark of the reference video.



This is where the music drop starts.



I'll provide:



The reference video

The music

All PNG assets

Google Drive folder containing everything:







Your objective is simple:



Take those five seconds and make me say...



"I need this person editing my entire music video."



This demo is your opportunity to showcase your creativity, technical skill, and attention to detail.



What I'm Looking For



I'm not looking for someone who simply syncs cuts to the beat.



I'm looking for someone who understands how to build energy, create 
ntum, and make every beat feel impactful.



Every kick drum should feel intentional.



Every movement should feel motivated.



Every frame should contribute to the overall cinematic experience.



I'm looking for someone who understands:



Storyboard sequencing

Scene composition

Camera movement

Visual pacing

Escalation

Rhythm

Impact

Motion design

Professional transitions

Editing Style



Your editing should include techniques such as:



Advanced keyframing

Quad In / Quad Out curves

Custom easing

Smooth scaling

Position animation

Camera push-ins

Camera pull-outs

Motion blur

Overlay masking

Blend modes

Parallax

Dynamic transitions

Flash frames

Beat synchronized effects

Cinematic zooms

Speed ramps where appropriate

Layered visual effects



Every movement should feel smooth and intentional.



Nothing should feel robotic or linear.



Required Training Videos



I'll provide two YouTube videos that demonstrate the editing style and techniques I'm looking for.









Before creating your demo, I expect you to watch both videos carefully.



These videos explain many of the subtle editing techniques that separate an average edit from an exceptional one.



Examples include:



Proper keyframe easing

Motion curves

Position animation

Scaling techniques

Layer movement

Transition timing

Beat synchronization



These details matter.



Please Don't Skip the Details



Please don't submit a demo unless you're genuinely committed to reproducing the techniques shown in the reference videos.



I'm also a CapCut editor.

I understand these techniques and will immediately recognize whether they've been applied correctly.



I'm not looking for shortcuts.



I'm looking for someone who enjoys obsessing over the tiny details that make an edit feel professional.



I'd rather review five exceptional demos than fifty rushed ones.



Let's respect each other's time.



Creative Freedom



I don't expect you to copy my AI storyboard exactly.



You're welcome to improve it.



You're welcome to combine the AI-generated video with the PNG assets if you think it creates a stronger result.



If you have a better visual idea that improves the sequence while staying true to the story, I'm happy to see your creativity.



The goal isn't to follow instructions blindly.



The goal is to create the most exciting sequence possible.



Experience



Great work always speaks louder than the number of years you've been editing.



If your demo impresses me, that's what matters most.



How to Apply



Please start your application with the following:



1. Your experience level



Example:



I have 12 years of professional video editing experience.



or



I have 5 years of experience, but I believe my work demonstrates the level you're looking for.



2. Links to your best work



Please send only your strongest edits.



Quality is much more important than quantity.



3. Confirm you've watched both YouTube reference videos.

4. Download the project assets from the Google Drive folder below.



Google Drive:





I'm looking forward to seeing what you create.

title: Agency Ops Manager
description:
Who We Are

We're a growing digital ads agency that with a fully remote team.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who can own the entire operational + fulfilment side.



If you're the kind of person who sees a mess and instinctively wants to organize it, who doesn't wait to be told what needs doing, and who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes — this role is for you.



What This Role Actually Is

This is an ongoing, evolving operational role where you own the engine that keeps our service delivery running.

That means when a new client signs up and pays, you're the one kicking off the project. When a tea
mber is stuck, you're the one unblocking them. When a process is broken or slow, you're the one building the system to fix it. When a client needs an update, you're the one making sure it happens.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Project & Task Management

You'll manage everything inside ClickUp — creating tasks, building templates, automations, keeping statuses up to date, making sure projects are moving forward on schedule. When something stalls, you catch it before anyone else does.



Team Oversight

We have a small remote team across different time zones. You'll make sure everyone is clocking in on time, communicating in the right Slack channels, and delivering their work. When someone needs support, you provide it. When someone isn't pulling their weight, you address it.



Client Communication

You'll handle day-to-day client updates, follow-ups, and back-and-forth communication. You're the bridge between our clients and our team. Clients should feel looked after. your job is to provide an exceptional customer experience.



Systems, Automations & SOPs

As the business grows, new processes need to be built. You'll create automations, write SOPs, set up Slack channels and workflows, and continuously improve how we operate. If there's a better way to do something, you find it and build it.



General Operational Ownership

Things come up. Fires happen. New needs emerge. If it falls under "keeping the business running and delivering for clients," it's your responsibility. This role evolves as the business evolves — that's the nature of operations.



Tools You'll Use Daily



ClickUp 

Google Drive

Slack 

WhatsApp

Pabbly 

Claude 

GHL



Who You Are



You are a leader. You're proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do — you see what needs doing and you handle it.

You're organized and detail-oriented. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

You're reliable. You show up on time, every day, during the agreed window. No disappearing acts, no random schedule changes without notice.

You're a strong communicator. You can talk to clients professionally and coordinate a remote team clearly.

You're comfortable building systems. Whether it's an automation, an SOP, or a new workflow in ClickUp, you can figure it out and build it.

You're not precious about scope. Operations means owning whatever needs to happen to keep things running. If the business needs something new from you that's within the operational function, you step up — you don't negotiate every new task.

You have experience managing remote teams and working with project management tools.



BONUS:

Experience in the following tech skills are highly preferred:

- GoHighLevel (automations, pipelines, calendars, funnels, custom values, custom fields)

- GHL Meta Lead syncing & troubleshooting

- Domains, hosting, DNS &
 setups

- GA4, GTM, Meta pixels, tracking & event setup

- MS Clarity

- General troubleshooting across marketing tech tools





Schedule Requirements

This is important, so please read carefully.

Your 4-hour shift must fall within the 4:00 PM to 10:00 P
lbourne time window. This is because the rest of the team is active during this window, and the whole point of this role is to be available when the team is working.





What We Offer



A stable, ongoing role with a team that values reliability and ownership

The freedom of remote work with clear expectations

A founder who respects your time and doesn't micromanage — but expects you to own your function

Room to grow as the business grows





How to Apply

Send a short message explaining:



Your relevant experience managing operations for a remote team

Your experience with ClickUp, Slack, Automation tools and similar tools

Your current timezone and confirmation that you can work within the 4:00 PM – 10:00 P
lbourne time window

Why you're a good fit for a role where the scope naturally evolves over time



Keep it concise. We value clear communicators.

USA Immigration Lawyer is a leading immigration law platform operated by Ashoori Law, a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving clients worldwide. Through educational content, digital marketing, and client-focused service, we help individuals, families, entrepreneurs, and investors navigate the U.S. immigration process.

The Marketing Manager will oversee the firm's digital marketing strategy, lead generation systems, CRM operations, website optimization, and performance analytics. This role requires a combination of strategic planning, hands-on execution, and strong analytical skills.



The ideal candidate has experience managing marketing campaigns, optimizing sales funnels, and working with cross-functional teams to achieve measurable business results.

Identify new opportunities to generate qualified immigration leads.

Improve landing page conversion rates and user experience.

Optimize consultation booking flows and intake forms.

Analyze and improve lead-to-consultation conversion rates.

Identify and eliminate funnel bottlenecks.

CRM & Marketing Automation



Manage and optimize HubSpot CRM.

Create and improve automated
 campaigns and nurture sequences.

Build workflows that increase engagement and consultation bookings.

Track lead lifecycle stages and conversion performance.

Ensure website performance, speed, and conversion best practices.

Support SEO initiatives to increase organic traffic and visibility.

Content & Brand Marketing

 marketing, and social media.

title: Short Term Rental (STR)/ Airbnb Guest Services Coordinator/Can Lead to Management
description:
Short Term Rental or Hotel Experience is Required



We are a growing company and we are hiring another Guest Services Coordinator!



When applying, be sure to mention the type of experience you have in the subject heading. You must use one of the following titles in the subject heading of your application message to be considered for this position--either "STR Experience" (if you worked for a company that manages short term rentals, "Airbnb Experience" if you worked for the Website Company called Airbnb, or "Both STR and Airbnb Experience" if you have both work experiences. A fourth category is if you have no experience in either Airbnb or STR, but you do have Hotel Experience, in which case you would put Hotel Experience.



Interviews start soon. We are seeking a reliable and organized Guest Services Coordinator to assist with guest inquiries, schedule maintenance tasks, and collaborate with our housekeeping team to ensure a seamless guest experience; for our short term rental property management company that services approximately 30 listings.



We are looking for someone who can work exclusively with our team, rather than juggling multiple clients at the same time. Employees are expected to share their screen during their work shift. We realize this is out of the question for some, and that is the very reason we have that as a requirement. The persons that have a problem with this are the ones we need to screen for. If you have a problem with this, please save you and us both the time and not apply.



The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving. If you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment and are passionate about hospitality, we want to hear from you! Management potential/training/advancement and long term opportunity for the right individual. Interview schedule will be during the day during Central Time in the US, as will your work shift if you are hired. In your response confirm that you understand the time zone and your ability to work during those hours; please let us know whether or not you have experience working that shift, or that this will be the first time. The time shift is 8 AM - 4 or 5 PM Central Time, five to five and a half days per week, with the half day probably a weekend day. The most flexible candidates go to the front of the line.



US is on Daylight Savings Time currently.



Please follow all of the instructions in above mentioned posting for your application to be considered. We will only respond to those candidates that take the time to apply because they truly see a potential fit with us. In the interview process you will have the opportunity to meet and speak with the person we hired in 2025, that answered this same job posting, who has since been promoted to Management.



Lastly, in your response,

Please rate yourself on a scale of 1-10, with 10 being the highest, on the following:

1. Basic Math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, use of calculator)

2. Organization skills

3. Administration skills

4. Communication



Please provide a brief overview of your job experience including the following information for each job held:

1. job title, name of company

2. dates of employment

3. reason for leaving

4. starting pay and ending pay

(Please DO NOT send a description of what you did, responsibilities; I can rely strictly on the job title)



In addition, you may also provide a link to your resume, but it doesn't replace the need for above requested information. We just a very brief, easy to read outline of your experience. We are mostly concerned with jobs you have had for at least one year. We don't need every job you have had for a month or a couple of months. If you have those, we can so those when we look at your resume. Thank you for your interest in working with us!



DURING the interview process, please use only this platform to communicate. Please DO NOT use my
 address until hired.
